// ==========================================
// FEEDBACK MAIN COMPONENT (PAGINATION + FILTERS)
// ==========================================
export function Feedback() {
  const { t, user, login, content, refresh, notify, navigate } = useGuest();
  const [rating, setRating] = useState(0); // 0 = unselected by default
  const [hoverRating, setHoverRating] = useState(0);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [topic, setTopic] = useState('COURT');
  const [consent, setConsent] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [filterTopic, setFilterTopic] = useState('ALL');
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState('NEWEST');
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [req, setReq] = useState(requestId);
  const [localSubmissions, setLocalSubmissions] = useState([]);
  const reviewsContainerRef = useRef(null);

  const PAGE_SIZE = 6;

  const ratingDescriptions = {
    0: t('(Chạm vào ngôi sao để chọn từ 1 đến 5 sao)'),
    1: t('1 sao — 😞 Cần cải thiện nhiều'),
    2: t('2 sao — 🙁 Chưa hài lòng'),
    3: t('3 sao — 😐 Bình thường / Tạm ổn'),
    4: t('4 sao — 😊 Hài lòng & Dịch vụ tốt'),
    5: t('5 sao — 🌟 Tuyệt vời! Rất hài lòng')
  };

  const topics = [
    { value: 'COURT', label: t('Cơ sở & Mặt sân'), icon: '🏟️' },
    { value: 'SERVICE', label: t('Trọng tài & HLV'), icon: '👨‍⚖️' },
    { value: 'FACILITY', label: t('Tiện ích & Phục vụ'), icon: '🚿' },
    { value: 'WEBSITE', label: t('Website & Đặt sân'), icon: '💻' },
    { value: 'TOURNAMENT', label: t('Giải đấu & Sự kiện'), icon: '🏆' },
    { value: 'OTHER', label: t('Góp ý khác'), icon: '💬' }
  ];

  const submit = async e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!user) {
      login();
      return;
    }
    if (!rating || rating < 1) {
      setError(t('Vui lòng chọn số sao đánh giá (từ 1 đến 5 sao).'));
      return;
    }
    if (!message.trim() || message.trim().length < 10) {
      setError(t('Vui lòng nhập nội dung đánh giá chi tiết (tối thiểu 10 ký tự).'));
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      await api('/feedback', 'POST', { rating, message, topic, publishConsent: consent, requestId: req });

      const newReview = {
        id: 'local-' + Date.now(),
        userName: user.name || 'Hội viên Courtly',
        userRole: user.role === 'CUSTOMER' ? 'Khách hàng thân thiết' : 'Thành viên',
        userInitials: (user.name || 'U').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
        avatarBg: '#173c32',
        rating,
        topic,
        topicLabel: topics.find(tp => tp.value === topic)?.label || topic,
        date: 'Vừa xong',
        message,
        reply: {
          adminName: 'Ban Quản Lý Courtly Club',
          adminRole: 'Phản hồi tự động',
          date: 'Vừa xong',
          message:
            'Cảm ơn bạn đã gửi đánh giá! Ban Quản Lý đã tiếp nhận ý kiến của bạn và sẽ phản hồi chi tiết trong thời gian sớm nhất ạ. 🎾'
        }
      };

      setLocalSubmissions(prev => [newReview, ...prev]);
      setMessage('');
      setRating(0); // Reset to unselected
      setCurrentPage(1);
      setReq(requestId());
      notify(t('Cảm ơn bạn! Đánh giá đã được gửi thành công đến Ban Quản Lý Courtly.'));
      await refresh().catch(() => {});
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  // Combine local submissions + server feedbacks + seed showcase feedbacks
  const serverFeedbacks = (content.feedback || []).map(f => ({
    id: f.id,
    userName: f.displayName || 'Hội viên ẩn danh',
    userRole: 'Khách hàng đã trải nghiệm',
    userInitials: (f.displayName || 'HV').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
    avatarBg: '#334155',
    rating: f.rating || 5,
    topic: f.topic || 'OTHER',
    topicLabel: topics.find(tp => tp.value === f.topic)?.label || '💬 Đánh giá',
    date: f.createdAt ? new Date(f.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN') : 'Gần đây',
    message: f.message,
    reply: f.reply
      ? {
          adminName: 'Ban Quản Lý Courtly Club',
          adminRole: 'Phản hồi chính thức',
          date: 'Phản hồi sau kiểm duyệt',
          message: f.reply
        }
      : null
  }));

  const allFeedbacks = useMemo(() => {
    return [...localSubmissions, ...serverFeedbacks, ...INITIAL_SHOWCASE_FEEDBACKS];
  }, [localSubmissions, serverFeedbacks]);

  // Real stats calculated directly from feedbacks (NO FAKE CRITERIA BARS)
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = allFeedbacks.length;
    if (total === 0) return { avg: '5.0', total: 0, counts: { 5: 0, 4: 0, 3: 0, 2: 0, 1: 0 } };
    const counts = { 5: 0, 4: 0, 3: 0, 2: 0, 1: 0 };
    let sum = 0;
    allFeedbacks.forEach(f => {
      const r = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Math.round(f.rating || 5)));
      counts[r] = (counts[r] || 0) + 1;
      sum += f.rating || 5;
    });
    return {
      avg: (sum / total).toFixed(1),
      total,
      counts
    };
  }, [allFeedbacks]);

  // Filtered feedbacks
  const filteredFeedbacks = useMemo(() => {
    return allFeedbacks
      .filter(f => {
        if (filterTopic === 'ALL') return true;
        if (filterTopic === '5STAR') return f.rating === 5;
        if (filterTopic === '4STAR') return f.rating === 4;
        if (filterTopic === '3STAR') return f.rating <= 3;
        if (filterTopic === 'HAS_REPLY') return Boolean(f.reply);
        return f.topic === filterTopic;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortBy === 'RATING_DESC') return b.rating - a.rating;
        return 0; // Default order (newest first)
      });
  }, [allFeedbacks, filterTopic, sortBy]);

  // Pagination calculations
  const totalItems = filteredFeedbacks.length;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / PAGE_SIZE));
  const paginatedFeedbacks = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
    return filteredFeedbacks.slice(start, start + PAGE_SIZE);
  }, [filteredFeedbacks, currentPage, PAGE_SIZE]);

  const handlePageChange = newPage => {
    if (newPage < 1 || newPage > totalPages) return;
    setCurrentPage(newPage);
    if (reviewsContainerRef.current) {
      reviewsContainerRef.current.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }
  };

  const handleFilterChange = newFilter => {
    setFilterTopic(newFilter);
    setCurrentPage(1);
  };

  const currentDisplayRating = hoverRating || rating;

  return (
    <section className="ct-pad" style={{ maxWidth: 1160, margin: '0 auto', paddingBottom: 60 }}>
      {/* 1. HEADER SECTION */}
      <div className="gx-heading" style={{ marginBottom: 24, textAlign: 'center' }}>
        <span className="ct-eyebrow" style={{ color: '#173c32', letterSpacing: 2 }}>
          COURTLY · ĐÁNH GIÁ & GÓP Ý
        </span>
        <h1 style={{ fontSize: 32, margin: '8px 0 10px', color: '#173c32', letterSpacing: 'normal' }}>
          {t('Lắng nghe trải nghiệm · Hoàn thiện mỗi ngày')}
        </h1>
        <p style={{ fontSize: 14.5, color: '#52655a', maxWidth: 680, margin: '0 auto', lineHeight: 1.65 }}>
          {t(
            'Mỗi lượt đánh giá chân thực từ quý khách là cơ sở để Courtly liên tục nâng cao chất lượng sân bãi, dịch vụ trọng tài và tiện ích phục vụ.'
          )}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* 2. RATING SUMMARY SCORECARD (GENUINE STAR DISTRIBUTION, NO FAKE CRITERIA BARS) */}
      <div
        style={{
          background: '#ffffff',
          border: '1px solid #dce4d6',
          borderRadius: 16,
          padding: '24px 28px',
          marginBottom: 24,
          boxShadow: '0 4px 20px rgba(23,60,50,0.04)',
          display: 'grid',
          gridTemplateColumns: 'auto 1fr',
          gap: 36,
          alignItems: 'center'
        }}
      >
        {/* Overall Score */}
        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', paddingRight: 32, borderRight: '1px solid #eef2ea', minWidth: 160 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 46, fontWeight: 900, lineHeight: 1, color: '#173c32' }}>{stats.avg}</div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 3, margin: '8px 0 6px' }}>
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => {
              const full = s <= Math.round(Number(stats.avg));
              return (
                <Star
                  key={s}
                  size={20}
                  fill={full ? '#f59e0b' : '#f1f5f9'}
                  color={full ? '#d97706' : '#cbd5e1'}
                  strokeWidth={1}
                />
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: '#15803d', display: 'block' }}>
            {t('Chỉ số đánh giá cao')}
          </span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b', marginTop: 2, display: 'block' }}>
            {stats.total} {t('lượt đánh giá')}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Real Star Rating Distribution (Clickable to filter) */}
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 6 }}>
          {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map(stars => {
            const count = stats.counts[stars] || 0;
            const pct = stats.total > 0 ? Math.round((count / stats.total) * 100) : 0;
            const isFilterActive = filterTopic === (stars === 5 ? '5STAR' : stars === 4 ? '4STAR' : stars <= 3 ? '3STAR' : 'ALL');
            return (
              <div
                key={stars}
                onClick={() => handleFilterChange(stars === 5 ? '5STAR' : stars === 4 ? '4STAR' : '3STAR')}
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 12,
                  fontSize: 12.5,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  padding: '3px 6px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  background: isFilterActive ? '#f0fdf4' : 'transparent',
                  transition: 'background 0.15s ease'
                }}
                title={`Xem các đánh giá ${stars} sao`}
              >
                <div style={{ width: 44, fontWeight: 700, color: '#334155', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 3 }}>
                  <span>{stars}</span>
                  <Star size={13} fill="#f59e0b" color="#d97706" strokeWidth={1} />
                </div>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, background: '#f1f5f9', height: 8, borderRadius: 4, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                  <div
                    style={{
                      background: stars >= 4 ? '#10b981' : stars === 3 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444',
                      width: `${pct}%`,
                      height: '100%',
                      borderRadius: 4
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div style={{ width: 70, textAlign: 'right', color: '#64748b', fontSize: 12 }}>
                  <b>{pct}%</b> <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>({count})</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. INLINE REVIEW COMPOSER (ALWAYS VISIBLE RIGHT HERE, NO EXTRA BUTTON, NO SCROLLING DOWN) */}
      <div
        style={{
          background: '#ffffff',
          border: '1.5px solid #cfe0cb',
          borderRadius: 16,
          padding: '24px 26px',
          marginBottom: 28,
          boxShadow: '0 6px 24px rgba(23,60,50,0.06)'
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 16, borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f4ec', paddingBottom: 14 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
            <div
              style={{
                width: 42,
                height: 42,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                background: user ? '#173c32' : '#e2e8f0',
                color: user ? '#def46a' : '#64748b',
                display: 'grid',
                placeItems: 'center',
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: 800
              }}
            >
              {user ? (user.name || 'U').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() : '👤'}
            </div>
            <div>
              <strong style={{ fontSize: 15, color: '#173c32', display: 'block' }}>
                {user ? `Xin chào, ${user.name}` : t('Viết đánh giá trải nghiệm của bạn')}
              </strong>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: user ? '#15803d' : '#64748b', fontWeight: user ? 600 : 400 }}>
                {user ? (
                  '✓ Tài khoản hội viên đã xác thực'
                ) : (
                  <span>
                    Chưa đăng nhập ·{' '}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={login}
                      style={{
                        background: 'transparent',
                        border: 'none',
                        color: '#047857',
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        textDecoration: 'underline',
                        cursor: 'pointer',
                        padding: 0
                      }}
                    >
                      Đăng nhập ngay
                    </button>{' '}
                    để hiển thị tích xanh
                  </span>
                )}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b', background: '#f8faf6', padding: '4px 10px', borderRadius: 20, border: '1px solid #e2e8dc' }}>
            💬 Đánh giá công khai
          </span>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={submit} style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 16 }}>
          {/* STAR SELECTOR: BIG, PROMINENT, UNSELECTED BY DEFAULT */}
          <div style={{ background: '#fcfdfa', border: '1px solid #e7ede2', borderRadius: 12, padding: '14px 16px' }}>
            <label style={{ fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: 700, color: '#173c32', display: 'block', marginBottom: 8 }}>
              {t('Bạn chấm mấy sao cho buổi chơi tại Courtly?')} <span style={{ color: '#dc2626' }}>*</span>
            </label>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }} onMouseLeave={() => setHoverRating(0)}>
                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => {
                  const isFilled = s <= currentDisplayRating;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={s}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setRating(s);
                        setError('');
                      }}
                      onMouseEnter={() => setHoverRating(s)}
                      aria-label={`${s} sao`}
                      style={{
                        background: isFilled ? '#fef3c7' : '#ffffff',
                        border: isFilled ? '2px solid #f59e0b' : '1.5px solid #cbd5e1',
                        borderRadius: 10,
                        padding: '6px 10px',
                        cursor: 'pointer',
                        transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'center',
                        transform: currentDisplayRating === s ? 'scale(1.1)' : 'scale(1)',
                        boxShadow: isFilled ? '0 2px 8px rgba(245,158,11,0.25)' : 'none'
                      }}
                    >
                      <Star
                        size={28}
                        fill={isFilled ? '#f59e0b' : '#f8fafc'}
                        color={isFilled ? '#d97706' : '#94a3b8'}
                        strokeWidth={1.5}
                      />
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* RATING LABEL (DISSIPATES CONFUSION) */}
              <div
                style={{
                  fontSize: 14,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  color:
                    currentDisplayRating === 0
                      ? '#64748b'
                      : currentDisplayRating >= 4
                      ? '#15803d'
                      : currentDisplayRating === 3
                      ? '#b45309'
                      : '#dc2626',
                  fontStyle: currentDisplayRating === 0 ? 'italic' : 'normal'
                }}
              >
                {ratingDescriptions[currentDisplayRating]}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* MESSAGE TEXTAREA */}
          <div>
            <textarea
              value={message}
              onChange={e => {
                setMessage(e.target.value);
                if (error) setError('');
              }}
              required
              minLength={10}
              maxLength={2000}
              rows={3}
              placeholder={t(
                'Chia sẻ cảm nhận chi tiết của bạn về chất lượng mặt sân, độ nảy bóng, ánh sáng đèn LED, trọng tài hay tiện ích phòng tắm...'
              )}
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                padding: '12px 16px',
                borderRadius: 10,
                border: '1.5px solid #cfd7c9',
                background: '#ffffff',
                fontSize: 14,
                lineHeight: 1.6,
                resize: 'vertical',
                outline: 'none',
                boxSizing: 'border-box'
              }}
            />
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 4, fontSize: 11.5, color: '#78897e' }}>
              <span>Tối thiểu 10 ký tự</span>
              <span>{message.length} / 2000 ký tự</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* TOPIC SELECTION PILLS */}
          <div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 700, color: '#173c32', marginBottom: 6 }}>
              {t('Chủ đề nhận xét (tùy chọn):')}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {topics.map(tp => {
                const active = topic === tp.value;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={tp.value}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setTopic(tp.value)}
                    style={{
                      background: active ? '#173c32' : '#f8faf6',
                      color: active ? '#def46a' : '#2b4437',
                      border: active ? '1.5px solid #173c32' : '1px solid #d5dcce',
                      borderRadius: 20,
                      padding: '5px 12px',
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: active ? 700 : 500,
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      display: 'inline-flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: 4,
                      transition: 'all 0.15s ease'
                    }}
                  >
                    <span>{tp.icon}</span>
                    <span>{tp.label}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* CONSENT & ERROR */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12 }}>
            <label
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 8,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                fontSize: 12.5,
                color: '#475569'
              }}
            >
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={consent}
                onChange={e => setConsent(e.target.checked)}
                style={{ accentColor: '#173c32' }}
              />
              <span>{t('Cho phép hiển thị đánh giá công khai trên trang web của CLB')}</span>
            </label>

            {/* SUBMIT BUTTON */}
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={busy}
              style={{
                background: '#173c32',
                color: '#def46a',
                border: 'none',
                padding: '11px 26px',
                borderRadius: 30,
                fontSize: 14,
                fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: busy ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 8,
                boxShadow: '0 4px 14px rgba(23,60,50,0.18)',
                marginLeft: 'auto'
              }}
            >
              <span>🎾</span>
              <span>
                {busy
                  ? t('Đang gửi…')
                  : user
                  ? t('Gửi đánh giá')
                  : t('Đăng nhập để gửi đánh giá')}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <div
              style={{
                background: '#fef2f2',
                border: '1px solid #fecaca',
                color: '#991b1b',
                padding: '10px 14px',
                borderRadius: 8,
                fontSize: 13
              }}
            >
              ⚠️ {error}
            </div>
          )}
        </form>
      </div>

      {/* 4. REVIEWS CONTAINER & FILTER TOOLBAR */}
      <div ref={reviewsContainerRef}>
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 12,
            marginBottom: 20
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {[
              { id: 'ALL', label: `${t('Tất cả')} (${allFeedbacks.length})` },
              { id: '5STAR', label: `5 ⭐ (${stats.counts[5] || 0})` },
              { id: '4STAR', label: `4 ⭐ (${stats.counts[4] || 0})` },
              { id: '3STAR', label: `≤ 3 ⭐ (${(stats.counts[3] || 0) + (stats.counts[2] || 0) + (stats.counts[1] || 0)})` },
              { id: 'HAS_REPLY', label: '💬 ' + t('Có phản hồi BQL') }
            ].map(tab => {
              const active = filterTopic === tab.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={tab.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleFilterChange(tab.id)}
                  style={{
                    background: active ? '#173c32' : '#ffffff',
                    color: active ? '#def46a' : '#394d40',
                    border: active ? '1px solid #173c32' : '1px solid #d5dcce',
                    borderRadius: 20,
                    padding: '6px 14px',
                    fontSize: 12.5,
                    fontWeight: active ? 700 : 500,
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    transition: 'all 0.15s ease'
                  }}
                >
                  {tab.label}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* SORTING SELECT */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, fontSize: 12.5, color: '#52655a' }}>
            <span>{t('Sắp xếp:')}</span>
            <select
              value={sortBy}
              onChange={e => setSortBy(e.target.value)}
              style={{
                padding: '6px 10px',
                borderRadius: 8,
                border: '1px solid #cfd7c9',
                background: '#ffffff',
                fontSize: 12.5,
                color: '#173c32',
                cursor: 'pointer'
              }}
            >
              <option value="NEWEST">{t('Mới nhất')}</option>
              <option value="RATING_DESC">{t('Đánh giá cao nhất')}</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 5. 2-COLUMN RESPONSIVE REVIEWS GRID (BALANCED, CLEAN, CRISP) */}
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'grid',
            gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(460px, 1fr))',
            gap: 18,
            alignItems: 'stretch'
          }}
        >
          {paginatedFeedbacks.map(item => (
            <article
              key={item.id}
              style={{
                background: '#ffffff',
                border: '1px solid #e2e8dc',
                borderRadius: 14,
                padding: '22px 24px',
                boxShadow: '0 3px 14px rgba(23,60,50,0.03)',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                justifyContent: 'space-between'
              }}
            >
              <div>
                {/* CUSTOMER HEADER */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    alignItems: 'flex-start',
                    flexWrap: 'wrap',
                    gap: 10,
                    marginBottom: 12
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                    <div
                      style={{
                        width: 42,
                        height: 42,
                        borderRadius: '50%',
                        background: item.avatarBg || '#173c32',
                        color: '#ffffff',
                        display: 'grid',
                        placeItems: 'center',
                        fontSize: 15,
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        boxShadow: '0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)'
                      }}
                    >
                      {item.userInitials || 'HV'}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                        <strong style={{ fontSize: 14.5, color: '#173c32' }}>{item.userName}</strong>
                        <span
                          style={{
                            background: '#ecfdf5',
                            color: '#047857',
                            border: '1px solid #a7f3d0',
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            padding: '1px 7px',
                            borderRadius: 10
                          }}
                        >
                          ✓ {item.userRole || t('Đã trải nghiệm')}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div
                        style={{
                          display: 'flex',
                          alignItems: 'center',
                          gap: 8,
                          marginTop: 3,
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: '#637269'
                        }}
                      >
                        <span>{item.date}</span>
                        <span>·</span>
                        <span style={{ color: '#173c32', fontWeight: 600 }}>{item.topicLabel}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* STARS (CRISP, CLEAR) */}
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2 }}>
                    {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => {
                      const filled = s <= item.rating;
                      return (
                        <Star
                          key={s}
                          size={16}
                          fill={filled ? '#f59e0b' : '#f1f5f9'}
                          color={filled ? '#d97706' : '#cbd5e1'}
                          strokeWidth={1}
                        />
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* REVIEW MESSAGE */}
                <p
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 14,
                    color: '#334155',
                    lineHeight: 1.65,
                    margin: '0 0 14px',
                    whiteSpace: 'pre-line'
                  }}
                >
                  "{item.message}"
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* ADMIN REPLY BLOCK */}
              {item.reply && (
                <div
                  style={{
                    background: '#f4f7ee',
                    borderLeft: '3.5px solid #173c32',
                    borderRadius: '0 10px 10px 0',
                    padding: '12px 16px',
                    marginTop: 10
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 5 }}>
                    <div
                      style={{
                        width: 22,
                        height: 22,
                        borderRadius: '50%',
                        background: '#173c32',
                        color: '#def46a',
                        display: 'grid',
                        placeItems: 'center',
                        fontSize: 11
                      }}
                    >
                      🎾
                    </div>
                    <strong style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: '#173c32' }}>{item.reply.adminName}</strong>
                    <span
                      style={{
                        background: '#173c32',
                        color: '#def46a',
                        fontSize: 10,
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        padding: '1px 5px',
                        borderRadius: 4
                      }}
                    >
                      {item.reply.adminRole}
                    </span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#637269', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                      {item.reply.date}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#27382f', lineHeight: 1.55, margin: 0, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
                    {item.reply.message}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
            </article>
          ))}

          {paginatedFeedbacks.length === 0 && (
            <div
              style={{
                gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                textAlign: 'center',
                padding: '48px 20px',
                background: '#ffffff',
                borderRadius: 14,
                border: '1px dashed #cfd7c9',
                color: '#637269'
              }}
            >
              <span>🔍 {t('Không tìm thấy đánh giá phù hợp với bộ lọc hiện tại.')}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* 6. PAGINATION CONTROLS */}
        {totalPages > 1 && (
          <div
            style={{
              marginTop: 24,
              padding: '14px 20px',
              background: '#ffffff',
              border: '1px solid #dce2d6',
              borderRadius: 12,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
              gap: 12
            }}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: '#52655a' }}>
              Hiển thị <b>{(currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE + 1}</b> –{' '}
              <b>{Math.min(currentPage * PAGE_SIZE, totalItems)}</b> trên tổng số <b>{totalItems}</b> đánh giá
            </span>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              {/* PREV BUTTON */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage - 1)}
                disabled={currentPage === 1}
                style={{
                  background: '#ffffff',
                  border: '1px solid #cfd7c9',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  padding: '6px 12px',
                  fontSize: 12.5,
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  color: currentPage === 1 ? '#9ca3af' : '#173c32',
                  cursor: currentPage === 1 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 4
                }}
              >
                <ChevronLeft size={14} />
                <span>{t('Trước')}</span>
              </button>

              {/* NUMBER BUTTONS */}
              {Array.from({ length: totalPages }, (_, i) => i + 1).map(num => {
                const active = num === currentPage;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={num}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handlePageChange(num)}
                    style={{
                      width: 32,
                      height: 32,
                      borderRadius: 6,
                      border: active ? 'none' : '1px solid #cfd7c9',
                      background: active ? '#173c32' : '#ffffff',
                      color: active ? '#def46a' : '#173c32',
                      fontSize: 12.5,
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      cursor: 'pointer'
                    }}
                  >
                    {num}
                  </button>
                );
              })}

              {/* NEXT BUTTON */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage + 1)}
                disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
                style={{
                  background: '#ffffff',
                  border: '1px solid #cfd7c9',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  padding: '6px 12px',
                  fontSize: 12.5,
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  color: currentPage === totalPages ? '#9ca3af' : '#173c32',
                  cursor: currentPage === totalPages ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 4
                }}
              >
                <span>{t('Tiếp')}</span>
                <ChevronRight size={14} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 7. CLUB SERVICE COMMITMENTS & SLA */}
      <div style={{ marginTop: 48, marginBottom: 24 }}>
        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 20 }}>
          <span className="ct-eyebrow" style={{ color: '#173c32', letterSpacing: 2 }}>
            COURTLY QUALITY PROMISE
          </span>
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: 22, margin: '6px 0 0', color: '#173c32' }}>

```jsx
import React from 'react';
import {Sun, House, Crown, Check, Construction} from 'lucide-react';
import {useGuest, money, zone} from './context';

const zones = [
  {id:'A', name:'Ngoài trời', style:'outdoor', Icon:Sun},
  {id:'B', name:'Trong nhà', style:'indoor', Icon:House},
  {id:'V', name:'VIP', style:'vip', Icon:Crown},
];

export default function CourtMap({courts, selected, onSelect, availability, rangeLabel, courtSelections = {}}) {
  const {t} = useGuest();
  return <section className="gx-map-section" aria-labelledby="guest-court-map-title">
    <div className="gx-block-heading">
      <div>
        <span className="gx-step">01</span>
        <h2 id="guest-court-map-title">{t('Chọn sân của bạn')}</h2>
      </div>
      <span>{rangeLabel || t('Chạm vào sân để xem hoặc chọn giờ')}</span>
    </div>
    <div className="dg-board" aria-label={t('Bản đồ sân')}>
      {zones.filter(z=>courts.some(c=>zone(c)===z.id)).map(({id, name, style, Icon}) => {
        const items = courts.filter(court => zone(court) === id);
        return <section className={`dg-zone dg-${style}`} key={id} aria-label={`${t('Khu')} ${id} · ${t(name)}`}>
          <div className="dg-zone-head"><Icon aria-hidden="true"/><div><h3>{t(name)}</h3><span>{t('Khu')} {id} · {items.length} {t('sân')}</span></div></div>
          <div className="dg-zone-courts">{items.map(court => {
            const maintenance = court.status !== 'ACTIVE';
            const busy = !maintenance && availability(court) === false;
            const chosen = court.id === selected?.id;
            const courtSel = courtSelections[court.id];
            const hasRange = Boolean(courtSel && courtSel.valid);
            const status = maintenance ? 'Bảo trì' : hasRange ? `✓ ${courtSel.rangeLabel}` : busy ? 'Bận trong giờ đã chọn' : chosen ? 'Đang xem' : rangeLabel ? 'Còn trống' : 'Xem lịch';
            return <button key={court.id} type="button" data-court-id={court.name} aria-pressed={chosen || hasRange}
              aria-label={`${court.name} · ${t(name)} · ${t(status)} · ${money(court.price)} / ${t('giờ')}`}
              className={`dg-court ${maintenance ? 'gm-maintenance' : busy ? 'gm-busy' : ''} ${chosen ? 'chosen' : ''}`}
              style={hasRange ? {borderColor: '#16a34a', background: '#f0fdf4', boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.2)'} : {}}
              disabled={maintenance} onClick={() => onSelect(court)}>
              <span className="dg-art" aria-hidden="true">
                {id === 'A' && <><span className="dg-fence"/><span className="dg-light dg-light-left"/><span className="dg-light dg-light-right"/></>}
                {id === 'B' && <><span className="dg-building"/><span className="dg-roof"/></>}
                {id === 'V' && <><span className="dg-vip-frame"/><span className="dg-crown"><Crown/></span></>}
                <span className="dg-field"><span className="dg-service"/><span className="dg-net"/></span>
                <span className="dg-maintenance-mark"><Construction/></span>
                <span className="dg-selected" style={hasRange ? {display: 'flex', background: '#16a34a', color: '#fff'} : {}}><Check/></span>
              </span>
              <span className="dg-court-caption">
                <strong className="dg-court-id">{court.name}</strong>
                <span className="gm-court-state" style={hasRange ? {color: '#15803d', fontWeight: 700} : {}}>{t(status)}</span>
              </span>
              <span className="gx-map-price">{money(court.price)} <span>/ {t('giờ')}</span></span>
            </button>;
          })}</div>
          {!items.length && <p className="gx-map-empty">{t('Chưa có sân trong khu này.')}</p>}
        </section>;
      })}
    </div>
    <p className="gx-map-note">{t('Chạm vào từng sân để chọn giờ. Có thể chọn tối đa 3 sân cùng lúc trong cùng một đơn đặt.')}</p>
  </section>;
}
```

import React, { useState, useMemo, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ArrowUpRight, Menu, LogOut, ChevronDown, Phone, Mail, MapPin, Clock, Bell, CheckCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { money, today as dateToday } from '../utils/format';
import {useGuest} from './context';
import {customerNavigation} from '../navigation';
export function Logo(){const {navigate,t}=useGuest();return <button className="ct-logo" onClick={()=>navigate('about')} aria-label={t('Courtly trang chủ')}><img src="/favicon.svg" width="38" height="38" alt=""/><span className="ct-original-wordmark">Courtly<em>TENNIS CLUB</em></span></button>;}

export function CustomerNotifications() {
  const { t, user, data, navigate, show, pay, login } = useGuest();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [readIds, setReadIds] = useState(() => {
    try {
      if (!user?.id) return [];
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(`courtly_read_notifs_${user.id}`);
      return stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });

  const menuRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e) => {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(e.target)) {
        setOpen(false);
      }
    };
    if (open) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.id) {
      try {
        const stored = localStorage.getItem(`courtly_read_notifs_${user.id}`);
        setReadIds(stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : []);
      } catch {}
    }
  }, [user?.id]);

  const notifications = useMemo(() => {
    if (!user || !data) return [];
    const list = [];
    const todayStr = dateToday();
    const orders = data.orders || [];

    // 1. Matches today
    orders.forEach(o => {
      const oDate = o.date || o.slots?.[0]?.scheduleDate || '';
      const courtName = data.courts?.find(c => c.id === o.slots?.[0]?.court)?.name || t('Sân Tennis');
      const timeRange = `${o.slots?.[0]?.hour || 0}:00 – ${(o.slots?.at(-1)?.hour || 0) + 1}:00`;
      
      if (oDate === todayStr && o.status === 'CONFIRMED') {
        list.push({
          id: `match-today-${o.id}`,
          type: 'today_match',
          icon: '🎾',
          title: t('Trận đấu hôm nay sẵn sàng check-in'),
          description: `${courtName} · ⏰ ${timeRange} · Mã vé: CT-${o.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}`,
          date: oDate,
          actionLabel: t('Mở vé QR'),
          action: () => show({ kind: 'ticket', order: o }),
          urgent: true
        });
      } else if (oDate === todayStr && o.status === 'CHECKED_IN') {
        list.push({
          id: `match-playing-${o.id}`,
          type: 'playing',
          icon: '⚡',
          title: t('Đang sử dụng sân'),
          description: `${courtName} · ⏰ ${timeRange} · Quý khách có thể gia hạn thêm giờ nếu cần`,
          date: oDate,
          actionLabel: t('Gia hạn sân'),
          action: () => show({ kind: 'extend', order: o }),
          urgent: false
        });
      }
    });

    // 2. Orders holding / awaiting deposit
    orders.filter(o => o.status === 'HOLDING').forEach(o => {
      const courtName = data.courts?.find(c => c.id === o.slots?.[0]?.court)?.name || t('Sân Tennis');
      list.push({
        id: `order-holding-${o.id}`,
        type: 'deposit_due',
        icon: '⏳',
        title: t('Đơn giữ chỗ cần thanh toán cọc'),
        description: `Đơn #${o.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()} (${courtName}) · Cọc cần thanh toán: ${money(o.deposit)}`,
        date: o.date,
        actionLabel: t('Thanh toán cọc'),
        action: () => pay('ORDER', o.id, 'DEPOSIT'),
        urgent: true
      });
    });

    // 3. Orders cancelled with refund status
    orders.filter(o => ['CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED'].includes(o.status)).forEach(o => {
      const settlement = o.cancellationSettlement || o.metadata?.cancellationSettlement;
      const refunded = o.finance?.refunded || 0;
      const refundPending = o.finance?.refundPending || (settlement ? settlement.refundAmount : 0);
      
      if (refunded > 0) {
        list.push({
          id: `order-refunded-${o.id}`,
          type: 'refunded',
          icon: '💰',
          title: t('Đã hoàn tiền đơn hủy'),
          description: `Đơn #${o.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()} đã được hoàn ${money(refunded)} thành công.`,
          date: o.date,
          actionLabel: t('Xem đơn'),
          action: () => navigate('orders'),
          urgent: false
        });
      } else if (refundPending > 0) {
        list.push({
          id: `order-refund-pending-${o.id}`,
          type: 'refund_pending',
          icon: '⏳',
          title: t('Khoản hoàn cọc đang chờ xử lý'),
          description: `Đơn #${o.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()} được duyệt hoàn ${money(refundPending)}. Quầy đang xử lý đối chiếu.`,
          date: o.date,
          actionLabel: t('Xem chi tiết'),
          action: () => navigate('orders'),
          urgent: false
        });
      }
    });

    // 4. Upcoming confirmed matches
    orders.filter(o => o.status === 'CONFIRMED' && (o.date || o.slots?.[0]?.scheduleDate) > todayStr)
      .slice(0, 3)
      .forEach(o => {
        const courtName = data.courts?.find(c => c.id === o.slots?.[0]?.court)?.name || t('Sân Tennis');
        const timeRange = `${o.slots?.[0]?.hour || 0}:00 – ${(o.slots?.at(-1)?.hour || 0) + 1}:00`;
        list.push({
          id: `match-upcoming-${o.id}`,
          type: 'upcoming',
          icon: '📅',
          title: t('Lịch thi đấu sắp tới'),
          description: `${o.date} · ${courtName} · ${timeRange}`,
          date: o.date,
          actionLabel: t('Xem vé'),
          action: () => show({ kind: 'ticket', order: o }),
          urgent: false
        });
      });

    // 5. Membership notice
    if (data.membership && data.membership.active) {
      list.push({
        id: `membership-active-${data.membership.id || 'current'}`,
        type: 'membership',
        icon: '👑',
        title: t('Hội viên CLB Courtly'),
        description: t(`Bạn đang sở hữu gói ${data.membership.planName || 'Hội viên'}. Tận hưởng ưu đãi giảm giá và ưu tiên giữ chỗ.`),
        actionLabel: t('Xem thẻ hội viên'),
        action: () => navigate('membership'),
        urgent: false
      });
    }

    return list;
  }, [user, data, t, navigate, show, pay]);

  const unreadCount = user ? notifications.filter(n => !readIds.includes(n.id)).length : 0;

  const markAllRead = () => {
    const allIds = notifications.map(n => n.id);
    setReadIds(allIds);
    if (user?.id) {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(`courtly_read_notifs_${user.id}`, JSON.stringify(allIds));
      } catch {}
    }
  };

  const markOneRead = (id) => {
    if (!readIds.includes(id)) {
      const next = [...readIds, id];
      setReadIds(next);
      if (user?.id) {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(`courtly_read_notifs_${user.id}`, JSON.stringify(next));
        } catch {}
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="ct-notif-wrapper" ref={menuRef} style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="ct-notif-bell-btn"
        onClick={() => setOpen(prev => !prev)}
        aria-label={t('Thông báo đơn hàng')}
        title={t('Thông báo đơn hàng')}
        style={{
          position: 'relative',
          background: open ? '#173c32' : '#ffffff',
          border: '1.5px solid ' + (open ? '#173c32' : 'rgba(23, 60, 50, 0.16)'),

      >

      </button>

          color: '#1e293b'
        }}>
          <div style={{
            padding: '12px 16px',

            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between'
          }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>🔔</span>
              <strong style={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#0f172a' }}>{t('Thông báo của bạn')}</strong>
              {unreadCount > 0 && (
                <span style={{
                  background: '#fee2e2',
                  color: '#b91c1c',
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  padding: '1px 6px',
                  borderRadius: 10
                }}>
                  {unreadCount} {t('mới')}

            </div>

          {!user ? (

              <p style={{ margin: '0 0 16px', fontSize: 13, color: '#64748b', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>

                {notifications.length === 0 ? (
                  <div style={{ padding: '34px 16px', textAlign: 'center', color: '#64748b', fontSize: 13 }}>

                    {t('Hiện tại bạn không có thông báo nào mới.')}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  notifications.map(n => {
                    const isUnread = !readIds.includes(n.id);
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={n.id}
                        style={{
                          padding: '11px 14px',
                          borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                          background: isUnread ? '#f0fdf4' : '#ffffff',
                          display: 'flex',
                          gap: 10,
                          alignItems: 'flex-start',
                          transition: 'background 0.15s'
                        }}
                      >
                        <span style={{ fontSize: 20, marginTop: 1 }}>{n.icon}</span>
                        <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                            <b style={{ fontSize: 12.8, color: isUnread ? '#166534' : '#1e293b', fontWeight: isUnread ? 700 : 600 }}>
                              {n.title}
                            </b>
                            {isUnread && <span style={{ width: 7, height: 7, borderRadius: '50%', background: '#22c55e', flexShrink: 0 }} />}
                          </div>
                          <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#475569', margin: '3px 0 6px', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>
                            {n.description}
                          </p>
                          {n.actionLabel && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                markOneRead(n.id);
                                setOpen(false);
                                n.action();
                              }}
                              style={{
                                background: n.urgent ? '#15803d' : '#e2ebd9',
                                color: n.urgent ? '#ffffff' : '#173c32',
                                border: 'none',
                                borderRadius: 5,
                                padding: '4px 10px',
                                fontSize: 11.5,
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                cursor: 'pointer',
                                display: 'inline-flex',
                                alignItems: 'center',
                                gap: 4
                              }}
                            >
                              {n.actionLabel} →
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </div>

              <div style={{
                padding: '9px 16px',
                background: '#f8fafc',
                borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                textAlign: 'center'
              }}>
                <button

                  }}
                >
                  {t('Xem danh sách tất cả đơn')} →
                </button>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Overview() {

        onClick={() => {
          if (preferredZone === 'ALL') setPreferredZone('A');
          navigate('booking');
        }}
      >
        {t('Tìm giờ trống')}
        <ArrowUpRight />
      </Action>
    </section>
  );

  function render(n, key) {
    if (typeof n === 'string') return t(n.trim());
    const a = n.attrs || {};
    if (a.class === 'ct-quick-book') return <React.Fragment key={key}>{quick}</React.Fragment>;
    if ('data-overview-events' in a)
      return (
        <EventCards
          key={key}
          events={(data?.tournaments || []).filter(x => x.start >= dateToday() && x.status === 'OPEN').slice(0, 3)}
        />
      );
    if ('data-overview-events-empty' in a) return null;
    if (a.class === 'ce-proposal' || a.class === 'haus-fine-print') return null;
    if (a['data-lucide']) {
      const I = icons[a['data-lucide']] || ArrowUpRight;
      return <I key={key} aria-hidden="true" />;
    }
    const props = { key };
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(a)) {
      if (k === 'style' || k === 'hidden') continue;
      if (k === 'class') props.className = v;
      else if (k === 'aria-label') props[k] = t(v);
      else if (k === 'src') props[k] = v.replace('assets/images/', '/guest/');
      else props[k] = v === null ? '' : v;
    }
    const dest = a['data-page'] || a['data-info'];
    if (dest) props.onClick = () => navigate(dest === 'courts' ? 'booking' : dest === 'overview' ? 'about' : dest);
    if (a['data-choose-court'])
      props.onClick = () => {
        setPreferredZone(a['data-choose-court'][0]);
        navigate('booking');
      };
    if ('data-book-referee' in a) props.onClick = () => navigate('booking');
    if (a.class === 'ce-ref-rate')
      return (
        <div className="ce-ref-rate" key={key}>
          <strong>{t('Trọng tài theo lịch trống thực tế')}</strong>
          <span>{t('Phí được tính riêng theo khoảng giờ đã chọn.')}</span>
        </div>
      );
    return React.createElement(n.tag, props, ...n.children.map((c, i) => render(c, key + '-' + i)));
  }

  return (
    <>
      {render(tree, 'overview')}

      {/* TESTIMONIALS STRIP ON HOMEPAGE */}
      <section
        className="ct-pad"
        style={{
          maxWidth: 1200,
          margin: '20px auto 40px',
          padding: '40px 24px',
          borderTop: '1px solid #e3e9dd'
        }}
      >
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'flex-end',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 16,
            marginBottom: 28
          }}
        >
          <div>
            <span className="ct-eyebrow" style={{ color: '#173c32', letterSpacing: 2 }}>
              COMMUNITY VOICES · 4.9 ★ (280+ ĐÁNH GIÁ)
            </span>
            <h2 style={{ fontSize: 28, color: '#173c32', margin: '8px 0 0', fontWeight: 800 }}>
              {t('Trải nghiệm thực tế từ cộng đồng người chơi 🎾')}
            </h2>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => navigate('feedback')}
            style={{
              background: '#173c32',
              color: '#def46a',
              border: 'none',
              borderRadius: 30,
              padding: '10px 20px',
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: 700,
              cursor: 'pointer',
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 6
            }}
          >
            <MessageSquare size={14} />
            <span>{t('Xem tất cả & Viết đánh giá')}</span>
            <ArrowUpRight size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div
          style={{
            display: 'grid',
            gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr))',
            gap: 20
          }}
        >
          {FEATURED_TESTIMONIALS.map((item, idx) => (
            <div
              key={idx}
              style={{
                background: '#ffffff',
                border: '1px solid #dce4d6',
                borderRadius: 16,
                padding: '24px',
                boxShadow: '0 4px 18px rgba(23,60,50,0.04)',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                justifyContent: 'space-between'
              }}
            >
              <div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 14 }}>

import React,{useState,useEffect,useRef} from 'react';
import QRCode from 'qrcode';
import {Copy,CheckCircle2,ArrowRight} from 'lucide-react';
import {api} from '../services/api';
import {useGuest,Action,State,Empty,money} from './context';

function PaymentCountdown({ expiresAt, t }) {
  const [sec, setSec] = useState(() => {
    if (!expiresAt) return 0;
    return Math.max(0, Math.floor((new Date(expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now()) / 1000));
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!expiresAt) return;
    const i = setInterval(() => {
      const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.floor((new Date(expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now()) / 1000));
      setSec(remaining);
      if (remaining <= 0) clearInterval(i);
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(i);
  }, [expiresAt]);

  const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
  const s = sec % 60;
  const formatted = `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  if (sec <= 0) {
    return (
      <div style={{ color: '#dc2626', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        ⚠️ {t('Đã hết thời hạn giữ chỗ đơn đặt. Nếu chưa chuyển tiền, vui lòng quay lại đặt sân mới.')}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{
      textAlign: 'center',
      marginBottom: 12,
      padding: '8px 12px',
      background: '#fffbeb',
      border: '1px solid #fde68a',
      borderRadius: 6,
      color: '#92400e',
      fontSize: 13,
      fontWeight: 600
    }}>
      ⏱️ {t('Thời gian giữ chỗ VietQR còn lại')}: <span style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700, color: '#b45309' }}>{formatted}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

export function PaymentDialog({intent,onClose}){
  const {t,refresh,notify,navigate}=useGuest();
  const lastStatus=useRef(intent.status);
  const [current,setCurrent]=useState(intent);
  const [qr,setQr]=useState('');
  const [busy,setBusy]=useState(false);
  const [error,setError]=useState('');


  const fallbackVietQrUrl = current.amount && current.reference
    ? `https://img.vietqr.io/image/${current.bankBin || '970422'}-${current.accountNumber || '0345678999'}-compact2.png?amount=${current.amount}&addInfo=${current.reference}&accountName=${encodeURIComponent(current.accountName || 'CLB TENNIS COURTLY')}`
    : null;
  const qrSrc = qr || current.qrImageUrl || fallbackVietQrUrl;

  // Generate standard VietQR QR canvas from EMVCo payload
  useEffect(()=>{
    if(current.qrPayload){
      QRCode.toDataURL(current.qrPayload,{width:320,margin:1,errorCorrectionLevel:'M'})
        .then(setQr)
        .catch(()=>setError(t('Không thể tạo QR. Dùng nội dung chuyển khoản bên dưới.')));
    }
  },[current.qrPayload]);

  // Realtime polling check for bank transaction
  useEffect(()=>{
    let live=true;
    const timer=setInterval(()=>{
      api('/transfers').then(rows=>{
        const found=rows.find(r=>r.id===intent.id);
        if(live&&found){
          setCurrent(found);
          if(found.status!==lastStatus.current){
            lastStatus.current=found.status;
            refresh().catch(()=>{});
          }
        }
      }).catch(()=>{});
    },3000);
    return()=>{live=false;clearInterval(timer)};
  },[intent.id,refresh]);

  const action=async(path,b={})=>{
    setBusy(true);setError('');

        </Action>

    );
  }

  return (

      </p>
      <PaymentCountdown expiresAt={current.expiresAt} t={t} />

      {/* VietQR Display */}
      <div className="gx-qr" style={{

        <div style={{fontSize:11.5,color:'#64748b',marginTop:10,textAlign:'center',maxWidth:260,lineHeight:1.4}}>

export function PaymentChoice({onChoose}){
 const {t}=useGuest();const [busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[online,setOnline]=useState(null);
 useEffect(()=>{let live=true;api('/public/payment-config').then(c=>{if(live)setOnline(Boolean(c.onlineEnabled&&c.bankConfigured))}).catch(()=>{if(live)setOnline(false)});return()=>{live=false}},[]);
 return <div className="gx-form"><h2>{t('Chọn phương thức thanh toán')}</h2><p>{t('Tiền chỉ được ghi nhận khi nhân viên thu tiền mặt hoặc ngân hàng gửi xác minh chuyển khoản.')}</p><Action disabled={busy||online===false} onClick={async()=>{setBusy(true);try{await onChoose('BANK_TRANSFER')}finally{setBusy(false)}}}>{t('Chuyển khoản VietQR')}</Action>{online===false&&<p>{t('Chuyển khoản hiện chưa khả dụng. Vui lòng thanh toán tại quầy.')}</p>}<Action secondary disabled={busy} onClick={()=>onChoose('CASH')}>{t('Tiền mặt tại quầy')}</Action></div>;
}

export default function Payments(){
  const {t,data,transfers,pay}=useGuest();
  return (
    <section className="ct-pad">
      <div className="gx-heading">
        <span className="ct-eyebrow">COURTLY / {t('TÀI KHOẢN')}</span>

        <p>{t('Tiền đã nhận và yêu cầu chuyển khoản được theo dõi riêng biệt, minh bạch.')}</p>
      </div>

      <h2>{t('Yêu cầu thanh toán chuyển khoản')}</h2>
      <div className="gx-records">
        {transfers.map(x=><article key={x.id}>
          <header>
            <b>{x.reference}</b>
            <State value={x.status}/>
          </header>
          <p>{t(x.type)} • {money(x.amount)}</p>
          <p>{t('Đã xác nhận thu')}: {money(x.received)} • {t('Tiền cần đối soát')}: {money(x.reviewAmount)}</p>
          <Action secondary onClick={()=>pay(null,null,null,x)}>{t('Xem mã QR thanh toán')}</Action>
        </article>)}
      </div>
      {!transfers.length&&<Empty/>}

      <h2>{t('Phiếu thu đã xác nhận')}</h2>

function Modal({children,onClose,title,hideClose}){
  const ref=useRef();
  useEffect(()=>{
    const old=document.activeElement,overflow=document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
    ref.current?.querySelector('button,input')?.focus();
    const handler=e=>{
      if(e.key==='Escape')onClose();
      if(e.key==='Tab'){
        const all=[...ref.current.querySelectorAll('button,input,select,textarea,a[href],summary')].filter(x=>!x.disabled&&x.getClientRects().length);
        if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===all[0]){e.preventDefault();all.at(-1)?.focus()}
        else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===all.at(-1)){e.preventDefault();all[0]?.focus()}
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown',handler);
    return()=>{
      document.body.style.overflow=overflow;
      document.removeEventListener('keydown',handler);
      old?.focus()
    }
  },[]);
  return <div className="gx-backdrop" onMouseDown={e=>e.target===e.currentTarget&&onClose()}><section className="gx-dialog" ref={ref} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={title}>{!hideClose && <button className="gx-close" aria-label={title} onClick={onClose}><X/></button>}{children}</section></div>;
}

                  notify(t(`Chào mừng trở lại, ${s.user.name || 'bạn'}!`));
                  if (authContext?.from === 'booking' || route === 'booking') {
                    navigate('booking');

              }}

            :dialog.kind==='zalo'?<ZaloZnsDialog order={dialog.order} onClose={()=>setDialog(null)}/>
            :dialog.kind==='extend'?<ExtendCourtDialog order={dialog.order} onClose={()=>setDialog(null)}/>

            :dialog.kind==='payment'?<PaymentDialog intent={dialog.intent} onClose={()=>setDialog(null)}/>
            :dialog.kind==='event'?<EventDialog event={dialog.event} onClose={()=>setDialog(null)}/>
            :dialog.kind==='article'?<Article article={dialog.article}/>
            :dialog.kind==='cancel'?<CancelDialog order={dialog.order} onClose={()=>setDialog(null)}/>
            :null}
          </Modal>
        )}

        <div className="gx-toast" role="status" aria-live="polite">
          {toast && t(toast)}
        </div>
      </div>
    </GuestContext.Provider>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';

import { useGuest, Action, Empty, money, zone } from './context';
import { WEEK_DAYS, getCourtMatrix } from './pricing.mjs';

const TABS = [
  { id: 'A', name: 'Sân Ngoài Trời', Icon: Sun, defaultMin: 120000, baseRate: 160000 },
  { id: 'B', name: 'Mái Che Trong Nhà', Icon: House, defaultMin: 180000, baseRate: 240000 },
  { id: 'V', name: 'Sân VIP Clubhouse', Icon: Crown, defaultMin: 300000, baseRate: 400000 }
];

export default function Pricing() {
  const { t, data, setPreferredZone, navigate } = useGuest();
  const [selectedZone, setSelectedZone] = useState('A');
  const [modalCell, setModalCell] = useState(null);

  const settings = data?.settings || {};
  const policies = settings.policies || {};

  // Find representative court for the category (all courts in same category have identical uniform rate)
  const currentTab = TABS.find(z => z.id === selectedZone) || TABS[0];
  const courtsInZone = (data?.courts || []).filter(c => zone(c) === selectedZone && c.status !== 'DELETED');
  const rawActive = courtsInZone.find(c => c.status === 'ACTIVE') || courtsInZone[0];
  const activeCourt = rawActive ? { ...rawActive, price: currentTab.baseRate } : { id: selectedZone, name: currentTab.name, price: currentTab.baseRate, type: selectedZone === 'A' ? 'OUTDOOR' : selectedZone === 'B' ? 'INDOOR' : 'VIP' };

  // Dynamic minimum price for each zone based on current court prices & pricing rules
  const getTabMinPrice = (tabId, defaultFallback) => {
    const courtsInThisZone = (data?.courts || []).filter(c => zone(c) === tabId && c.status !== 'DELETED');
    if (!courtsInThisZone.length) return defaultFallback;
    const repCourt = courtsInThisZone.find(c => c.status === 'ACTIVE') || courtsInThisZone[0];
    const m = getCourtMatrix(repCourt, data?.prices || []);
    if (m && m.length > 0) {
      let minVal = Infinity;
      for (const block of m) {
        for (const dayKey of Object.keys(block.days || {})) {
          const p = block.days[dayKey]?.price;
          if (p && p < minVal) minVal = p;
        }
      }
      if (minVal !== Infinity) return minVal;
    }
    return Math.round(Number(repCourt.price || defaultFallback) * 0.75);
  };

  // Calculate pricing matrix for active court
  const matrix = activeCourt ? getCourtMatrix(activeCourt, data?.prices || []) : [];

  const handleCellClick = (block, dayKey, dayData) => {
    const dayMeta = WEEK_DAYS.find(d => d.key === dayKey);
    const isDiscount = dayData.type === 'flash';
    const origPrice = isDiscount ? Math.round(dayData.price / 0.75) : dayData.price;
    const depositPercent = settings.depositPercent || 30;
    const depositPrice = Math.round((dayData.price * depositPercent) / 100);

    setModalCell({
      block,
      dayMeta,
      price: dayData.price,
      origPrice,
      isDiscount,
      depositPercent,
      depositPrice,
      courtName: activeCourt?.name || t('Sân Tennis')
    });
  };

  const handleBookNow = () => {
    setPreferredZone(selectedZone);
    setModalCell(null);
    navigate('booking');
  };

  return (
    <section className="ct-pad gx-pricing" style={{ maxWidth: 1200, margin: '0 auto' }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="gx-heading" style={{ marginBottom: 28 }}>
        <span className="ct-eyebrow" style={{ color: '#6b8274', letterSpacing: '0.15em', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 12 }}>
          COURTLY · {t('BẢNG GIÁ NIÊM YẾT 2026')}
        </span>
        <h1 style={{ color: '#173c32', fontSize: 'clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px)', fontWeight: 800, margin: '8px 0 12px' }}>
          {t('Bảng giá sân theo ngày & khung giờ')}
        </h1>
        <p style={{ color: '#52655a', fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 1.6, maxWidth: 720 }}>
          {t('Biểu phí chuẩn theo giờ và phân bổ riêng biệt cho từng ngày trong tuần. Khung Giờ Vàng (-25%) tự động áp dụng trực tiếp khi tạo đơn.')}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* 1. HORIZONTAL TABS SELECTOR (HÀNG NGANG GỌN GÀNG, KHÔNG CÓ CHỮ NHỎ SÂN 1-4, KHÔNG CÓ Ô ĐƠN VỊ) */}
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.1em', color: '#6b8274' }}>
            {t('Chọn loại sân')}:
          </span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#52655a' }}>
            {t('Nhấp vào tab để xem biểu giá tương ứng')}
          </span>

                  padding: '12px 18px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  border: isActive ? '2px solid #173c32' : '1px solid #cbd2c2',
                  background: isActive ? '#173c32' : '#fffefa',

      {/* 2. THE EXCEL MATRIX TABLE */}
      <div style={{ background: '#fffefa', borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid #cbd2c2', overflow: 'hidden', boxShadow: '0 2px 12px rgba(23,60,50,0.06)', marginBottom: 36 }}>

        <div style={{ background: '#edf1e6', padding: '12px 18px', borderBottom: '1px solid #cbd2c2', display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>

              {t(TABS.find(z => z.id === selectedZone)?.name || 'Sân Ngoài Trời')}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 16, fontSize: 11, color: '#52655a' }}>
            <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, color: '#15803d', fontWeight: 600 }}>
              <span style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: '50%', background: '#15803d' }} /> {t('Giờ Vàng (-25%)')}
            </span>
            <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, color: '#9a3412', fontWeight: 600 }}>

            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Matrix Table */}
        <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>

// Schedule boundaries, rather than fixed slot counts, also support older 60-minute slots.
export const toMinutes = value => {
  const [hour, minute] = String(value).split(':').map(Number);
  return hour * 60 + minute;
};
export const clock = value => `${String(Math.floor(value / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(value % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
export function rangeSlots(rows, start, end) {
  return rows.filter(row => toMinutes(row.start) >= start && toMinutes(row.end) <= end)
    .sort((a, b) => toMinutes(a.start) - toMinutes(b.start));
}
export function canEndAt(rows, start, end, available) {
  if (start === null || end <= start) return false;
  const selected = rangeSlots(rows, start, end);
  return selected.length > 0 && toMinutes(selected[0].start) === start
    && toMinutes(selected.at(-1).end) === end
    && selected.every((row, i) => available(row) && (!i || toMinutes(selected[i - 1].end) === toMinutes(row.start)));
}
export function timePoints(rows) {
  return [...new Set(rows.flatMap(row => [toMinutes(row.start), toMinutes(row.end)]))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
}

const stamp=n=>`${String(Math.floor(n)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(Math.round((n%1)*60)).padStart(2,'0')}`;
// Segment both calendars at every tariff boundary; gaps use the court's base price.
export function tariffRows(court,prices){
 const rates=prices.filter(p=>p.court===court.id);
 const boundaries=[...new Set([6,23,...rates.flatMap(p=>[Number(p.start),Number(p.end)]).filter(n=>n>6&&n<23)])].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
 const price=(day,start)=>rates.find(p=>p.dayType===day&&Number(p.start)<=start&&Number(p.end)>start)?.price??court.price;
 return boundaries.slice(0,-1).map((start,i)=>({start:stamp(start),end:stamp(boundaries[i+1]),weekday:price('WEEKDAY',start),weekend:price('WEEKEND',start)}));
}

export const WEEK_DAYS = [
  { key: 'mon', dayNum: 1, label: 'Thứ 2', short: 'Mon', dayType: 'WEEKDAY' },
  { key: 'tue', dayNum: 2, label: 'Thứ 3', short: 'Tue', dayType: 'WEEKDAY' },
  { key: 'wed', dayNum: 3, label: 'Thứ 4', short: 'Wed', dayType: 'WEEKDAY' },
  { key: 'thu', dayNum: 4, label: 'Thứ 5', short: 'Thu', dayType: 'WEEKDAY' },
  { key: 'fri', dayNum: 5, label: 'Thứ 6', short: 'Fri', dayType: 'WEEKDAY' },
  { key: 'sat', dayNum: 6, label: 'Thứ 7', short: 'Sat', dayType: 'WEEKEND' },
  { key: 'sun', dayNum: 7, label: 'Chủ Nhật', short: 'Sun', dayType: 'WEEKEND' }
];

export const STANDARD_TIME_BLOCKS = [
  { start: 6, end: 9, time: '06:00 – 09:00', label: 'Sáng sớm', type: 'normal' },
  { start: 9, end: 13, time: '09:00 – 13:00', label: 'Giờ vàng trưa', type: 'flash', discountPercent: 25 },
  { start: 13, end: 16, time: '13:00 – 16:00', label: 'Giờ vàng chiều', type: 'flash', discountPercent: 25 },
  { start: 16, end: 18, time: '16:00 – 18:00', label: 'Chiều mát', type: 'peak' },
  { start: 18, end: 21, time: '18:00 – 21:00', label: 'Cao điểm đèn', type: 'peak' },
  { start: 21, end: 23, time: '21:00 – 23:00', label: 'Đêm muộn', type: 'normal' }
];

export function getSlotPrice(court, prices, dayObj, startHour) {
  if (!court) return 140000;
  
  // Base price defined on court (e.g., 160.000đ for outdoor, 240.000đ for indoor, 400.000đ for VIP)
  const basePrice = Number(court.price || court.basePrice || 140000);
  const isWeekend = dayObj.dayType === 'WEEKEND';

  // 1. Weekend Pricing Rules (Thứ 7 & Chủ Nhật)
  if (isWeekend) {
    if (startHour >= 18 && startHour < 23) {
      // Weekend Night Peak (Đèn cao áp cuối tuần đông khách nhất): +50%
      return Math.round((basePrice * 1.5) / 1000) * 1000;
    }
    // Weekend Day (06:00 - 18:00): +25%
    return Math.round((basePrice * 1.25) / 1000) * 1000;
  }

  // 2. Weekday Pricing Rules (Thứ 2 - Thứ 6)
  if (startHour >= 9 && startHour < 16) {
    // Golden Hour Off-Peak (09:00 - 16:00): Flash sale -25% discount to boost utilization
    return Math.round((basePrice * 0.75) / 1000) * 1000;
  }
  
  if (startHour >= 16 && startHour < 18) {
    // Cool Afternoon Peak (16:00 - 18:00 tan tầm chiều mát): +25%
    return Math.round((basePrice * 1.25) / 1000) * 1000;
  }

  if (startHour >= 18 && startHour < 21) {
    // Night Prime Peak (18:00 - 21:00 giờ vàng tối bật dàn đèn LED 500 Lux): +40% (hoặc ~340k với sân 240k)
    return Math.round((basePrice * 1.4) / 1000) * 1000;
  }

  // Standard early morning (06:00 - 09:00) & Late night (21:00 - 23:00): Exactly 100% Base Price
  return basePrice;
}

export function getCourtMatrix(court, prices) {
  return STANDARD_TIME_BLOCKS.map(block => {
    const days = {};
    WEEK_DAYS.forEach(d => {
      const p = getSlotPrice(court, prices, d, block.start);
      days[d.key] = {
        price: p,
        type: d.dayType === 'WEEKEND' ? 'weekend' : block.type,
        dayLabel: d.label
      };
    });
    return {
      ...block,
      days
    };
  });
}
