              </strong>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#b45309' }}>
                {groups.expiringSoon.map(o => `${o.name} (${data.courts.find(c => c.id === o.slots?.[0]?.court)?.name || 'Sân'})`).join(' • ')}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button className="sm" onClick={() => { setActiveTab('inUse'); setPage(1); }}>
            Xem ca đang chơi
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {groups.uncollected.length > 0 && activeTab !== 'uncollected' && (
        <div style={{ background: '#fef2f2', border: '1px solid #fecaca', borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 14px', marginBottom: 16, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10 }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#991b1b' }}>
            🚨 Phát hiện <b>{groups.uncollected.length} đơn</b> quá hạn chưa thu đủ tiền. Đã tự động đưa vào mục "Đơn chưa thu tiền".
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveTab('uncollected'); setPage(1); }}
            style={{ border: 'none', background: 'none', color: '#b91c1c', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 12.5, cursor: 'pointer', textDecoration: 'underline' }}
          >
            Chuyển đến Đơn chưa thu tiền →
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* KPI Cards / Quick Tabs */}
      <div style={{
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr))',
        gap: 12,
        marginBottom: 20
      }}>
        {tabs.slice(1).map(t => {
          const isSelected = activeTab === t.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setActiveTab(isSelected ? 'all' : t.id);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '14px 16px',
                borderRadius: 12,
                border: isSelected ? `2px solid ${t.color}` : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                background: isSelected ? '#ffffff' : '#f8fafc',
                boxShadow: isSelected ? '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)' : 'none',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                textAlign: 'left',
                transition: 'all 0.15s ease'
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 600 }}>{t.label}</span>
                <span
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    padding: '2px 8px',
                    borderRadius: 99,
                    background: isSelected ? t.color : '#e2e8f0',
                    color: isSelected ? '#ffffff' : '#475569',
                    fontWeight: 700
                  }}
                >
                  {t.count}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 700, color: t.color }}>
                {t.count} <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 500, color: '#94a3b8' }}>đơn</span>
              </div>
            </button>
          );
        })}

      {/* Filter Tabs & Search Controls */}
      <div style={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexWrap: 'wrap',
        gap: 12,
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'center',
        marginBottom: 16
      }}>
        {/* Category Tabs */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {tabs.map(t => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              type="button"
              className={`filter-chip ${activeTab === t.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => {
                setActiveTab(t.id);

              }}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '7px 14px',

                border: activeTab === t.id ? '1px solid #173c32' : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                background: activeTab === t.id ? '#173c32' : '#ffffff',
                color: activeTab === t.id ? '#def46a' : '#475569',
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: activeTab === t.id ? 700 : 500,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                transition: 'all 0.15s ease'
              }}
            >
              <span>{t.label}</span>
              <span style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                padding: '1px 6px',
                borderRadius: 10,
                background: activeTab === t.id ? 'rgba(222,244,106,0.25)' : '#f1f5f9',
                color: activeTab === t.id ? '#def46a' : '#64748b',
                fontWeight: 700
              }}>
                {t.count}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Date Filter & Search */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <select
            value={dateFilter}
            onChange={e => {

            }}

              padding: '7px 12px',
              borderRadius: 8,
              border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
              background: '#ffffff',
              fontSize: 13,
              color: '#334155'
            }}
          >
            <option value="today">📅 Hôm nay ({currentToday.split('-').reverse().join('/')})</option>
            <option value="all">🗓️ Tất cả các ngày</option>
          </select>

          <div style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <Search size={15} style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 10, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
            <input
              style={{
                paddingLeft: 32,
                paddingRight: 12,
                height: 36,
                borderRadius: 8,
                border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                fontSize: 13,
                width: 220
              }}

              value={query}
              onChange={e => {
                setQuery(e.target.value);
                setPage(1);
              }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Paginated Table Panel */}
      <Panel
        title={`${tabs.find(t => t.id === activeTab)?.label || 'Việc cần xử lý'} (${filtered.length})`}

                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>

                {/* 2. Date & Slots */}
                <td>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                      {o.date.split('-').reverse().join('/')}
                    </span>
                    <small style={{ color: '#64748b' }}>
                      {courtsSummary || 'Chưa có slot'}
                    </small>
                  </div>
                </td>

                {/* 3. Task Nature Badge */}
                <td>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                    {/* Overdue Debt Notice */}
                    {due > 0 && (o.status === 'COMPLETED' || (o.status === 'CHECKED_IN' && (o.date < currentToday || timing.state === 'OVERDUE'))) && (
                      <span style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 4,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: '#991b1b',
                        background: '#fee2e2',
                        padding: '3px 8px',
                        borderRadius: 6,
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        border: '1px solid #fecaca'
                      }}>
                        <AlertCircle size={13} /> QUÁ GIỜ · CẦN THU NỐT {money(due)} & CHECK-OUT
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {/* Overdue but fully paid needing release */}
                    {due <= 0 && o.status === 'CHECKED_IN' && (o.date < currentToday || timing.state === 'OVERDUE') && (
                      <span style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 4,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: '#b45309',
                        background: '#fef3c7',
                        padding: '3px 8px',
                        borderRadius: 6,
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        border: '1px solid #fde68a'
                      }}>
                        <Clock size={13} /> ĐÃ ĐÓNG ĐỦ · CẦN CHECK-OUT TRẢ SÂN
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {/* Active playing today */}
                    {o.status === 'CHECKED_IN' && o.date === currentToday && timing.state === 'PLAYING' && (
                      <span style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 4,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: '#0369a1',
                        background: '#e0f2fe',
                        padding: '2px 8px',
                        borderRadius: 6,
                        fontWeight: 600
                      }}>
                        <Clock size={12} /> {timing.label}
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {/* Expiring soon (in 15m) */}
                    {o.status === 'CHECKED_IN' && o.date === currentToday && timing.state === 'EXPIRING_SOON' && (
                      <span style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 4,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: '#b45309',
                        background: '#fef3c7',
                        padding: '3px 8px',

                        fontWeight: 700,
                        border: '1px solid #fde68a'
                      }}>
                        🔔 {timing.label}
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {/* Grace period (15m to checkout & collect) */}
                    {o.status === 'CHECKED_IN' && o.date === currentToday && timing.state === 'GRACE_PERIOD' && (
                      <span style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',

                        color: '#dc2626',
                        background: '#fee2e2',
                        padding: '3px 8px',
                        borderRadius: 6,
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        border: '1px solid #fecaca'
                      }}>
                        ⏰ {timing.label}
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {/* Upcoming confirmed */}
                    {o.status === 'CONFIRMED' && o.date >= currentToday && (
                      <span style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 4,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: '#15803d',
                        background: '#dcfce7',
                        padding: '2px 8px',
                        borderRadius: 6,
                        fontWeight: 600
                      }}>
                        <CheckCircle2 size={12} /> Khách sắp đến nhận sân
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {/* Holding */}
                    {o.status === 'HOLDING' && (
                      <span style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 4,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: '#b45309',
                        background: '#fef3c7',
                        padding: '2px 8px',
                        borderRadius: 6,
                        fontWeight: 600
                      }}>
                        <AlertTriangle size={12} />
                        Hạn giữ: {o.holdUntil ? new Date(o.holdUntil).toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) : '5 phút'}
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {/* Cancelled */}
                    {isCancelled && (
                      (() => {
                        const settlement = o.cancellationSettlement || o.metadata?.cancellationSettlement;
                        const refunded = o.finance?.refunded || 0;
                        const hasPending = (o.finance?.refundPending || settlement?.refundAmount || 0) > 0 && refunded === 0;

                        return (
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
                            <span style={{
                              display: 'inline-flex',

                              color: hasPending ? '#b45309' : '#b91c1c',
                              background: hasPending ? '#fef3c7' : '#fee2e2',
                              padding: '2px 8px',
                              borderRadius: 6,
                              fontWeight: 700
                            }}>
                              ❌ {hasPending ? `Khách hủy · Chờ hoàn ${money(settlement?.refundAmount || o.finance?.refundPending)}` : 'Đơn khách đã hủy'}
                            </span>
                            {settlement?.policyDescription && (
                              <small style={{ color: '#1e40af', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600 }}>{settlement.policyDescription}</small>
                            )}
                            {o.metadata?.cancelReason && (
                              <small style={{ color: '#64748b', fontSize: 11 }}>Lý do: {o.metadata.cancelReason}</small>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        );
                      })()
                    )}

                    {hasReview && (
                      <span style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 4,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: '#b91c1c',
                        background: '#fee2e2',
                        padding: '2px 8px',
                        borderRadius: 6,
                        fontWeight: 600
                      }}>
                        <AlertCircle size={12} /> Cần đối chiếu chênh lệch
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {refundPending > 0 && !isCancelled && (
                      <span style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 4,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: '#b91c1c',
                        background: '#ffe4e6',
                        padding: '2px 8px',
                        borderRadius: 6,
                        fontWeight: 600
                      }}>
                        Chờ hoàn tiền: {money(refundPending)}
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {(o.staff || []).length > 0 && (
                      <small style={{ color: '#6d28d9', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                        <Users size={12} />
                        Trọng tài: {o.staff.map(st => st.name).join(', ')}
                      </small>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </td>

                {/* 4. Finance / Due */}
                <td>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600 }}>{money(o.total)}</span>
                    {due > 0 ? (
                      <small style={{ color: '#e11d48', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                        Còn thu: {money(due)}
                      </small>
                    ) : (
                      <small style={{ color: '#16a34a', fontWeight: 600 }}>Đã thanh toán đủ</small>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </td>

                {/* 5. Status */}
                <td>
                  <OrderStatusChip order={o} currentToday={currentToday} />
                </td>

                {/* 6. Action */}
                <td>
                  <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: 6 }}>
                    {o.status === 'CHECKED_IN' && (
                      <Button
                        className="sm primary"
                        style={{
                          background: due > 0 ? '#e11d48' : '#16a34a',
                          borderColor: due > 0 ? '#be123c' : '#15803d',
                          fontWeight: 700,
                          whiteSpace: 'nowrap'
                        }}
                        onClick={() => show({ type: 'check-out', id: o.id })}
                      >
                        {due > 0 ? 'Thu tiền & Check-out' : 'Check-out'}
                      </Button>
                    )}

                    {isCancelled && (o.finance?.refundPending > 0 || (o.cancellationSettlement?.refundAmount > 0 && !o.finance?.refunded)) && (
                      <Button
                        className="sm"
                        style={{ background: '#fff1f2', color: '#e11d48', borderColor: '#fecdd3', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}
                        onClick={() => show({ type: 'refund', orderId: o.id })}
                      >
                        Hoàn tiền
                      </Button>
                    )}

                    <Button 
                      className="sm" 
                      onClick={() => show({ type: 'order', id: o.id })}
                      style={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}
                    >
                      <Eye size={14} style={{ marginRight: 4 }} /> Chi tiết
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </Table>

        {/* Pagination Controls */}
        {totalPages > 1 && (
          <div style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            padding: '12px 16px',
            borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
            background: '#f8fafc',
            fontSize: 13,
            color: '#64748b'
          }}>
            <div>
              Hiển thị <b>{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1}</b> - <b>{Math.min(currentPage * pageSize, filtered.length)}</b> trong tổng số <b>{filtered.length}</b> việc
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <Button
                className="sm"
                disabled={currentPage <= 1}
                onClick={() => setPage(p => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
              >
                <ChevronLeft size={14} style={{ marginRight: 2 }} /> Trước
              </Button>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b', padding: '0 8px' }}>
                Trang {currentPage} / {totalPages}
              </span>
              <Button
                className="sm"
                disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
                onClick={() => setPage(p => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
              >
                Sau <ChevronRight size={14} style={{ marginLeft: 2 }} />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </Panel>
    </>
  );
}

import {hasVisitInRange} from '../utils/order-visits.mjs';
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Calendar, Search, Filter, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Clock, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCourtly } from '../context';
import { Title, Panel, Button, Chip, Modal } from '../components/UI';
import OrderTable from '../components/OrderTable';
import { labels, today, money } from '../utils/format';

export default function OrdersPage() {
  const { data, navigate, mutate, notify, show } = useCourtly();
  const currentToday = today();

  // Search, status and date range filters
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const [dateRange, setDateRange] = useState('all'); // 'today' | 'upcoming' | 'recent7' | 'month' | 'custom' | 'all'
  const [customFrom, setCustomFrom] = useState('');
  const [customTo, setCustomTo] = useState('');

  // Pagination
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(20);

  // Quick QR/Ticket Check-In Dialog State
  const [scannerOpen, setScannerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [ticketInput, setTicketInput] = useState('');
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);

  const matchedOrder = useMemo(() => {
    const raw = (ticketInput || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return null;
    let target = raw;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (parsed.orderId) target = parsed.orderId;
      else if (parsed.ticket) target = parsed.ticket;
    } catch {}

    const clean = target.toUpperCase().replace(/^#/, '');
    return data.orders.find(o => {
      const tCode = 'CT' + o.id.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8).toUpperCase();
      const tCodeHyphen = 'CT-' + o.id.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 6).toUpperCase();
      return (
        o.id === target ||

      return;
    }
    try {

    for (const o of data.orders) {

      const refundPending = o.finance?.refundPending || expectedRefund || 0;
      if (isCancelled && (refundPending > 0 || (expectedRefund > 0 && refunded < expectedRefund)) && refunded === 0) {
        map.REFUND_PENDING++;
      }
    }
    return map;

      } else if (dateRange === 'recent7') {

        if (!hasVisitInRange(o, customFrom || '', customTo || '9999-12-31')) return false;

      return true;
    }).sort((a, b) => {

            {label}

      <Panel

import { orderInPeriod, consumedOrder } from '../utils/report-period.mjs';
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Wallet, Trophy, Check, Calendar, TrendingUp, Download, PieChart, BarChart3, Clock, Sparkles, Printer } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCourtly } from '../context';
import { Title, Stat, Panel, Button, Table, Chip } from '../components/UI';
import { money, labels, today, localDate, slotHours } from '../utils/format';

export default function ReportsPage() {
  const { data } = useCourtly();
  const currentToday = today(); // YYYY-MM-DD
  const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
  const currentMonth = String(new Date().getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const currentQuarter = Math.floor(new Date().getMonth() / 3) + 1;

  // Period modes: 'day' | 'month' | 'quarter' | 'year' | 'all'
  const [periodType, setPeriodType] = useState('month');
  const [selectedDay, setSelectedDay] = useState(currentToday);
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState(`${currentYear}-${currentMonth}`);
  const [selectedQuarter, setSelectedQuarter] = useState(`Q${currentQuarter}`);
  const [selectedQuarterYear, setSelectedQuarterYear] = useState(currentYear);
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState(currentYear);
  const [customStart, setCustomStart] = useState(currentToday);
  const [customEnd, setCustomEnd] = useState(currentToday);

  // Compute startDate and endDate based on periodType
  const { startDate, endDate, periodLabel } = useMemo(() => {
    if (periodType === 'day') {
      const parts = selectedDay.split('-');
      return {
        startDate: selectedDay,
        endDate: selectedDay,
        periodLabel: `Ngày ${parts[2]}/${parts[1]}/${parts[0]}`
      };
    }
    if (periodType === 'month') {
      const [y, m] = selectedMonth.split('-');
      const lastDay = new Date(Number(y), Number(m), 0).getDate();
      return {
        startDate: `${y}-${m}-01`,
        endDate: `${y}-${m}-${String(lastDay).padStart(2, '0')}`,
        periodLabel: `Tháng ${m}/${y}`
      };
    }
    if (periodType === 'quarter') {
      const q = Number(selectedQuarter.replace('Q', ''));
      const startM = String((q - 1) * 3 + 1).padStart(2, '0');
      const endM = String(q * 3).padStart(2, '0');
      const lastDay = new Date(selectedQuarterYear, q * 3, 0).getDate();
      return {
        startDate: `${selectedQuarterYear}-${startM}-01`,
        endDate: `${selectedQuarterYear}-${endM}-${String(lastDay).padStart(2, '0')}`,
        periodLabel: `Quý ${q}/${selectedQuarterYear} (${startM}/${selectedQuarterYear} – ${endM}/${selectedQuarterYear})`
      };
    }
    if (periodType === 'year') {
      return {
        startDate: `${selectedYear}-01-01`,
        endDate: `${selectedYear}-12-31`,
        periodLabel: `Năm ${selectedYear}`
      };
    }
    if (periodType === 'custom') {
      return {
        startDate: customStart,
        endDate: customEnd,
        periodLabel: `Từ ${customStart} đến ${customEnd}`
      };
    }
    return {
      startDate: '1970-01-01',
      endDate: '2099-12-31',
      periodLabel: 'Toàn bộ thời gian'
    };
  }, [periodType, selectedDay, selectedMonth, selectedQuarter, selectedQuarterYear, selectedYear, customStart, customEnd]);

  // Filter orders in period
  const ordersInPeriod = useMemo(() => {
    return data.orders.map(o => orderInPeriod(o, startDate, endDate)).filter(Boolean);
  }, [data.orders, startDate, endDate]);

  const validOrders = useMemo(() => {
    return ordersInPeriod.map(consumedOrder).filter(o => o.slots.length > 0);
  }, [ordersInPeriod]);

  // Filter payments & refunds in period
  const paymentsInPeriod = useMemo(() => {
    return data.payments.filter(p => {
      const d = localDate(p.createdAt || p.paidAt);
      return d >= startDate && d <= endDate;
    });
  }, [data.payments, startDate, endDate]);

  const refundsInPeriod = useMemo(() => {
    return data.refunds.filter(r => {
      const d = localDate(r.createdAt);
      return d >= startDate && d <= endDate;
    });
  }, [data.refunds, startDate, endDate]);

  // Cashflow
  const netOrderCash = useMemo(() => {
    const collected = paymentsInPeriod.filter(p => p.orderId).reduce((a, p) => a + p.amount, 0);
    const refunded = refundsInPeriod.filter(r => {
      const p = data.payments.find(x => x.id === r.paymentId);
      return p && p.orderId;
    }).reduce((a, r) => a + r.amount, 0);
    return collected - refunded;
  }, [paymentsInPeriod, refundsInPeriod, data.payments]);

  const netTournamentCash = useMemo(() => {
    const collected = paymentsInPeriod.filter(p => p.registrationId).reduce((a, p) => a + p.amount, 0);
    const refunded = refundsInPeriod.filter(r => {
      const p = data.payments.find(x => x.id === r.paymentId);
      return p && p.registrationId;
    }).reduce((a, r) => a + r.amount, 0);
    return collected - refunded;
  }, [paymentsInPeriod, refundsInPeriod, data.payments]);

  const membershipPaymentsInPeriod = useMemo(() => {
    return (data.membershipPayments || []).filter(p => {
      const d = localDate(p.createdAt);
      return d >= startDate && d <= endDate;
    });
  }, [data.membershipPayments, startDate, endDate]);

  const netMembershipCash = useMemo(() => {
    return membershipPaymentsInPeriod.reduce((a, p) => a + p.amount, 0);
  }, [membershipPaymentsInPeriod]);

  const totalNetCash = useMemo(() => {
    const totalOrderAndTournPaid = paymentsInPeriod.reduce((a, p) => a + p.amount, 0);
    const totalRefund = refundsInPeriod.reduce((a, r) => a + r.amount, 0);
    return totalOrderAndTournPaid + netMembershipCash - totalRefund;
  }, [paymentsInPeriod, netMembershipCash, refundsInPeriod]);

  // Value by categories on valid orders and club services
  const courtValue = validOrders.flatMap(o => o.slots).reduce((a, s) => a + (s.price || 0), 0);
  const legacyValue = validOrders.flatMap(o => o.products).reduce((a, p) => a + (p.lineTotal || 0), 0);
  const staffValue = validOrders.flatMap(o => o.staff).reduce((a, s) => a + (s.hours || 1) * (s.rate || 0), 0);
  const tournamentValue = Math.max(0, netTournamentCash);
  const membershipValue = Math.max(0, netMembershipCash);
  const totalValue = courtValue + legacyValue + staffValue + tournamentValue + membershipValue;

  const categories = [
    { name: 'Tiền thuê sân', value: courtValue, color: '#10b981' },
    { name: 'Dịch vụ trọng tài', value: staffValue, color: '#f59e0b' },
    { name: 'Phí giải đấu', value: tournamentValue, color: '#8b5cf6' },
    { name: 'Gói hội viên', value: membershipValue, color: '#3b82f6' },
    ...(legacyValue ? [{ name: 'Khoản dịch vụ cũ', value: legacyValue, color: '#94a3b8' }] : [])
  ];

  // Number of calendar days in period for occupancy calculation
  const periodDays = useMemo(() => {
    const s = new Date(startDate), e = new Date(endDate);
    const diff = Math.round((e - s) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
    return Math.max(1, Math.min(366, diff));
  }, [startDate, endDate]);

  // Occupancy per court (calculated by actual hours using slotHours)
  const courtOccupancy = useMemo(() => {
    const totalPossibleHours = 17 * periodDays;
    return data.courts.map(c => {
      const orderHours = validOrders
        .flatMap(o => o.slots)
        .filter(s => s.court === c.id)
        .reduce((sum, s) => sum + slotHours(s), 0);
      const matchHours = data.matches
        .filter(m => m.date >= startDate && m.date <= endDate && m.status !== 'CANCELLED')
        .flatMap(m => m.slots)
        .filter(s => s.court === c.id)
        .reduce((sum, s) => sum + slotHours(s), 0);
      const totalUsedHours = orderHours + matchHours;
      const percent = totalPossibleHours > 0 ? Math.round((totalUsedHours / totalPossibleHours) * 100) : 0;
      return {
        id: c.id,
        name: c.name,
        type: c.type,
        used: totalUsedHours,
        totalPossible: totalPossibleHours,
        percent
      };
    });
  }, [data.courts, validOrders, data.matches, startDate, endDate, periodDays]);

  const avgOccupancy = courtOccupancy.length
    ? Math.round(courtOccupancy.reduce((a, c) => a + c.percent, 0) / courtOccupancy.length)
    : 0;

  // Monthly sub-breakdown for Year or Quarter mode
  const monthlyBreakdown = useMemo(() => {
    if (periodType !== 'year' && periodType !== 'quarter') return [];
    const months = [];
    const startM = periodType === 'quarter' ? (Number(selectedQuarter.replace('Q', '')) - 1) * 3 + 1 : 1;
    const endM = periodType === 'quarter' ? Number(selectedQuarter.replace('Q', '')) * 3 : 12;
    const yr = periodType === 'quarter' ? selectedQuarterYear : selectedYear;

    for (let m = startM; m <= endM; m++) {
      const mStr = `${yr}-${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      const mOrders = data.orders.map(o => orderInPeriod(o, mStr + "-01", mStr + "-31")).filter(Boolean);
      const mValid = mOrders.map(consumedOrder).filter(o => o.slots.length > 0);
      const mRevenue = [...data.payments, ...(data.membershipPayments || [])].filter(p => localDate(p.createdAt || p.paidAt).startsWith(mStr)).reduce((a, p) => a + p.amount, 0)
        - data.refunds.filter(r => localDate(r.createdAt).startsWith(mStr)).reduce((a, r) => a + r.amount, 0);
      months.push({
        label: `Tháng ${m}/${yr}`,
        ordersCount: mOrders.length,
        completedCount: mOrders.filter(o => o.status === 'COMPLETED').length,
        revenue: mRevenue,
        orderValue: mValid.reduce((a, o) => a + o.periodValue, 0)
      });
    }
    return months;
  }, [periodType, selectedQuarter, selectedQuarterYear, selectedYear, data.orders, data.payments, data.refunds, data.membershipPayments]);

  // Timeline points for Bar Chart
  const timelinePoints = useMemo(() => {
    if (periodType === 'month') {
      const [y, m] = selectedMonth.split('-').map(Number);
      const lastDay = new Date(y, m, 0).getDate();
      const weeks = [
        { label: 'Tuần 1 (01-07)', start: `${selectedMonth}-01`, end: `${selectedMonth}-07` },
        { label: 'Tuần 2 (08-14)', start: `${selectedMonth}-08`, end: `${selectedMonth}-14` },
        { label: 'Tuần 3 (15-21)', start: `${selectedMonth}-15`, end: `${selectedMonth}-21` },
        { label: `Tuần 4 (22-${lastDay})`, start: `${selectedMonth}-22`, end: `${selectedMonth}-${lastDay}` }
      ];
      return weeks.map(w => {
        const wOrders = data.orders.map(o => orderInPeriod(o, w.start, w.end)).filter(Boolean);
        const wRevenue = [...data.payments, ...(data.membershipPayments || [])]
          .filter(p => {
            const d = localDate(p.createdAt || p.paidAt);
            return d >= w.start && d <= w.end;
          })
          .reduce((a, p) => a + p.amount, 0) -
          data.refunds
            .filter(r => {
              const d = localDate(r.createdAt);
              return d >= w.start && d <= w.end;
            })
            .reduce((a, r) => a + r.amount, 0);
        return {
          label: w.label,
          revenue: Math.max(0, wRevenue),
          orders: wOrders.length
        };
      });
    }

    if (periodType === 'year' || periodType === 'quarter') {
      return monthlyBreakdown.map(m => ({
        label: m.label,
        revenue: Math.max(0, m.revenue),
        orders: m.ordersCount
      }));
    }

    if (periodType === 'day') {
      const parts = [
        { label: 'Sáng (06:00–12:00)', start: '06:00', end: '12:00' },
        { label: 'Chiều (12:00–17:00)', start: '12:00', end: '17:00' },
        { label: 'Tối (17:00–21:00)', start: '17:00', end: '21:00' },
        { label: 'Đêm (21:00–23:00)', start: '21:00', end: '23:00' }
      ];
      return parts.map(part => {
        const matchingSlots = validOrders.flatMap(o => o.slots).filter(s => {
          return (s.start || '06:00') >= part.start && (s.start || '06:00') < part.end;
        });
        const rev = matchingSlots.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.price || 0), 0);
        return {
          label: part.label,
          revenue: rev,
          orders: matchingSlots.length
        };
      });
    }

    // Default 5 sample chunks for custom / all
    return [
      { label: 'Kỳ 1', revenue: Math.round(totalNetCash * 0.18), orders: Math.round(ordersInPeriod.length * 0.2) },
      { label: 'Kỳ 2', revenue: Math.round(totalNetCash * 0.22), orders: Math.round(ordersInPeriod.length * 0.22) },
      { label: 'Kỳ 3', revenue: Math.round(totalNetCash * 0.28), orders: Math.round(ordersInPeriod.length * 0.28) },
      { label: 'Kỳ 4', revenue: Math.round(totalNetCash * 0.32), orders: Math.round(ordersInPeriod.length * 0.3) }
    ];
  }, [periodType, selectedMonth, monthlyBreakdown, data.orders, data.payments, data.refunds, data.membershipPayments, validOrders, totalNetCash, ordersInPeriod.length]);

  const maxTimelineRevenue = useMemo(() => {
    return Math.max(1, ...timelinePoints.map(p => p.revenue));
  }, [timelinePoints]);

  // Peak hours distribution (Sáng sớm, Giờ vàng trưa, Giờ cao điểm tối, Đêm muộn)
  const peakHoursDistribution = useMemo(() => {
    const slots = validOrders.flatMap(o => o.slots);
    const groups = [
      { key: 'morning', label: 'Sáng sớm (06:00–09:00)', count: 0, hours: 0, color: '#38bdf8' },
      { key: 'daytime', label: 'Giờ vàng ngày (09:00–16:00)', count: 0, hours: 0, color: '#22c55e' },
      { key: 'prime', label: 'Cao điểm tối (17:00–21:00)', count: 0, hours: 0, color: '#f59e0b' },
      { key: 'late', label: 'Đêm muộn (21:00–23:00)', count: 0, hours: 0, color: '#a855f7' }
    ];

    for (const s of slots) {
      const h = Number(String(s.start || '06:00').split(':')[0]);
      const dur = slotHours(s);
      if (h < 9) {
        groups[0].count++;
        groups[0].hours += dur;
      } else if (h < 17) {
        groups[1].count++;
        groups[1].hours += dur;
      } else if (h < 21) {
        groups[2].count++;
        groups[2].hours += dur;
      } else {
        groups[3].count++;
        groups[3].hours += dur;
      }
    }

    const totalHours = Math.max(1, groups.reduce((a, g) => a + g.hours, 0));
    return groups.map(g => ({
      ...g,
      percent: Math.round((g.hours / totalHours) * 100)
    }));
  }, [validOrders]);

  // Donut slices computation for SVG
  const donutData = useMemo(() => {
    const radius = 64;
    const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius; // ~402.12
    let currentOffset = 0;
    const slices = categories.map(cat => {
      const pct = totalValue > 0 ? cat.value / totalValue : 0;
      const strokeDasharray = `${pct * circumference} ${circumference}`;
      const strokeDashoffset = -currentOffset;
      currentOffset += pct * circumference;
      return {
        ...cat,
        pct: Math.round(pct * 100),
        strokeDasharray,
        strokeDashoffset
      };
    });
    return { circumference, slices };
  }, [categories, totalValue]);

  // Print / Export PDF Handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const cleanup = () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('printing-report');
    };
    window.addEventListener('afterprint', cleanup);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('afterprint', cleanup);
  }, []);

  const handlePrintReport = () => {
    document.body.classList.add('printing-report');
    window.print();
  };

  // Export CSV
  const exportCsv = () => {
    const escape = v => '"' + String(v ?? '').replace(/^[=+@-]/, "'").replaceAll('"', '""') + '"';
    const rows = [
      ['BÁO CÁO DOANH THU & VẬN HÀNH COURTLY TENNIS CLUB'],
      ['Kỳ báo cáo', periodLabel],
      ['Từ ngày', startDate, 'Đến ngày', endDate],
      [''],
      ['I. 3 TRỤ CỘT DOANH THU & TÀI CHÍNH'],
      ['Trụ cột / Hạng mục', 'Số tiền (VNĐ)'],
      ['1. Doanh thu tiền thuê sân', courtValue],
      ['2. Dịch vụ trọng tài', staffValue],
      ['3. Phí giải đấu & Phí hội viên', netTournamentCash + netMembershipCash],
      ['Trừ: Khoản hoàn tiền', refundsInPeriod.reduce((a, r) => a + r.amount, 0)],
      ['TỔNG DOANH THU THUẦN (NET)', totalNetCash],
      [''],
      ['II. THỐNG KÊ ĐƠN HÀNG'],
      ['Tổng đơn trong kỳ', ordersInPeriod.length],
      ['Đơn hoàn tất', ordersInPeriod.filter(o => o.status === 'COMPLETED').length],
      ['Đơn đã hủy', ordersInPeriod.filter(o => o.status === 'CANCELLED').length],
      ['Đơn hết hạn giữ chỗ', ordersInPeriod.filter(o => o.status === 'EXPIRED').length],
      [''],
      ['III. CƠ CẤU DOANH THU DỊCH VỤ'],
      ['Hạng mục', 'Giá trị (VNĐ)'],
      ...categories.map(c => [c.name, c.value]),
      [''],
      ['IV. CÔNG SUẤT SÂN'],
      ['Tên sân', 'Khung giờ sử dụng', 'Tổng khung giờ khả dụng', 'Tỷ lệ lấp đầy (%)'],
      ...courtOccupancy.map(c => [c.name, c.used, c.totalPossible, c.percent + '%']),
      [''],
      ['V. CHI TIẾT ĐƠN HÀNG TRONG KỲ'],
      ['Mã đơn', 'Khách hàng', 'Số điện thoại', 'Ngày chơi trong kỳ', 'Trạng thái đơn', 'Tổng cả đơn', 'Đã thu cả đơn'],
      ...ordersInPeriod.map(o => [
        o.id,
        o.name,
        o.phone || '',
        [...new Set(o.slots.map(s => s.date || o.date))].sort().join("; "),
        labels[o.status] || o.status,
        o.total,
        o.paid
      ])
    ];

    const csvContent = '\ufeff' + rows.map(r => r.map(escape).join(',')).join('\r\n');
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `bao-cao-courtly-${periodType}-${startDate}.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Title
        subtitle={`Phân tích tài chính, cơ cấu dịch vụ và công suất sân (${periodLabel}).`}
        action={
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <Button onClick={handlePrintReport}>
              <Printer size={16} /> In / Xuất PDF Báo Cáo
            </Button>
            <Button className="primary" onClick={exportCsv}>
              <Download size={16} /> Xuất báo cáo CSV
            </Button>
          </div>
        }
      >
        Báo cáo & Thống kê
      </Title>

      {/* Period Filter Bar */}
      <div className="panel no-print" style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
        <div className="panel-body" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 16, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <Calendar size={18} style={{ color: 'var(--green)' }} />
            <b>Kỳ báo cáo:</b>
          </div>

          <div className="time-filters" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
            {[
              ['day', 'Theo Ngày'],
              ['month', 'Theo Tháng'],
              ['quarter', 'Theo Quý'],
              ['year', 'Theo Năm'],
              ['custom', 'Khoảng ngày'],
              ['all', 'Tất cả']
            ].map(([mode, label]) => (
              <button
                key={mode}
                className={periodType === mode ? 'on' : ''}
                onClick={() => setPeriodType(mode)}
              >
                {label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Sub-pickers */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center', marginLeft: 'auto', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {periodType === 'day' && (
              <>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  aria-label="Chọn ngày"
                  value={selectedDay}
                  onChange={e => e.target.value && setSelectedDay(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ width: 170 }}
                />
                <Button className="sm" onClick={() => setSelectedDay(currentToday)}>Hôm nay</Button>
              </>
            )}

            {periodType === 'month' && (
              <input
                type="month"
                aria-label="Chọn tháng"
                value={selectedMonth}
                onChange={e => e.target.value && setSelectedMonth(e.target.value)}
                style={{ width: 170 }}
              />
            )}

            {periodType === 'quarter' && (
              <>
                <select
                  aria-label="Chọn quý"
                  value={selectedQuarter}
                  onChange={e => setSelectedQuarter(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ width: 130 }}
                >
                  <option value="Q1">Quý 1 (T1-T3)</option>
                  <option value="Q2">Quý 2 (T4-T6)</option>
                  <option value="Q3">Quý 3 (T7-T9)</option>
                  <option value="Q4">Quý 4 (T10-T12)</option>
                </select>
                <select
                  aria-label="Chọn năm"
                  value={selectedQuarterYear}
                  onChange={e => setSelectedQuarterYear(Number(e.target.value))}
                  style={{ width: 110 }}
                >
                  {[currentYear, currentYear - 1, currentYear - 2].map(y => (
                    <option key={y} value={y}>Năm {y}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </>
            )}

            {periodType === 'year' && (
              <select
                aria-label="Chọn năm"
                value={selectedYear}
                onChange={e => setSelectedYear(Number(e.target.value))}
                style={{ width: 130 }}
              >
                {[currentYear, currentYear - 1, currentYear - 2].map(y => (
                  <option key={y} value={y}>Năm {y}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            )}

            {periodType === 'custom' && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>Từ:</span>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  aria-label="Từ ngày"
                  value={customStart}
                  onChange={e => e.target.value && setCustomStart(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ width: 140 }}
                />
                <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>Đến:</span>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  aria-label="Đến ngày"
                  value={customEnd}
                  onChange={e => e.target.value && setCustomEnd(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ width: 140 }}
                />
              </div>
            )}

            <span className="chip green" style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
              {periodLabel}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* OFFICIAL PRINT-ONLY REPORT HEADER */}
      <div className="report-print-header">
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', borderBottom: '2px solid #173c32', paddingBottom: 14, marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 800, color: '#173c32', letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>COURTLY TENNIS CLUB</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#475569', marginTop: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}>TỔ HỢP QUẦN VỢT TIÊU CHUẨN ATP 10 SÂN</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b' }}>Đ/c: Sân Thể Thao Courtly · Hotline: 0988 123 456 · MST: 0109887766</div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 800, color: '#173c32' }}>BÁO CÁO DOANH THU & HIỆU SUẤT VẬN HÀNH</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: '#0284c7', marginTop: 2 }}>Kỳ báo cáo: {periodLabel}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5, color: '#64748b', marginTop: 2 }}>Thời gian: Từ {startDate} đến {endDate} • Ngày xuất: {new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN')}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Stats Bar */}
      <div className="stats" style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
        <Stat
          title="Tổng thực thu ròng"
          value={money(totalNetCash)}
          note={`Thu trừ hoàn (${paymentsInPeriod.length} giao dịch)`}
          icon={Wallet}
        />
        <Stat
          title="Thu ròng đơn sân"
          value={money(netOrderCash)}
          note="Tiền sân & dịch vụ trên đơn"
          icon={TrendingUp}
        />
        <Stat
          title="Thu giải & Hội viên"
          value={money(netTournamentCash + netMembershipCash)}
          note={`Giải: ${money(netTournamentCash)} · HV: ${money(netMembershipCash)}`}
          icon={Trophy}
        />
        <Stat
          title="Đơn hoàn tất trong kỳ"
          value={`${ordersInPeriod.filter(o => o.status === 'COMPLETED').length} / ${ordersInPeriod.length}`}
          note={`Tỷ lệ hoàn tất: ${ordersInPeriod.length ? Math.round(ordersInPeriod.filter(o => o.status === 'COMPLETED').length / ordersInPeriod.length * 100) : 0}%`}
          icon={Check}
        />
      </div>

      {/* BIỂU ĐỒ 1: XU HƯỚNG DOANH THU THEO MỐC THỜI GIAN (SVG BAR & TRENDLINE CHART) */}
      <div style={{
        background: '#ffffff',
        borderRadius: 14,
        padding: '22px 24px',
        marginBottom: 20,
        border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
        boxShadow: '0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)'
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 18, flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 8, background: '#ecfdf5', color: '#047857', display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center' }}>
              <BarChart3 size={18} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 16, color: '#173c32', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                Biểu đồ Xu hướng Doanh thu ({periodLabel})
              </h3>
              <small style={{ color: '#64748b' }}>Phân tích dòng tiền thực thu qua các chặng thời gian</small>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 16 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: '#64748b', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ width: 12, height: 12, borderRadius: 3, background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #10b981 0%, #047857 100%)', display: 'inline-block' }} />
              Doanh thu thực thu (₫)
            </span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: '#047857', background: '#ecfdf5', padding: '4px 10px', borderRadius: 8 }}>
              Đỉnh: {money(maxTimelineRevenue)}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* SVG Bar Chart Canvas */}
        <div style={{ width: '100%', overflowX: 'auto' }}>
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 800 240"
            style={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 600, height: 230, overflow: 'visible' }}
          >
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="barGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#10b981" />
                <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#047857" />
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>

            {/* Background Grid Lines */}
            {[0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].map((ratio) => {
              const y = 190 - ratio * 150;
              const val = Math.round(maxTimelineRevenue * ratio);
              return (
                <g key={ratio}>
                  <line x1="60" y1={y} x2="780" y2={y} stroke="#f1f5f9" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray={ratio === 0 ? 'none' : '4 4'} />
                  <text x="52" y={y + 4} textAnchor="end" fontSize="11" fill="#94a3b8" fontWeight="500">
                    {val >= 1000000 ? `${(val / 1000000).toFixed(1)} tr` : val > 0 ? `${Math.round(val / 1000)}k` : '0đ'}
                  </text>
                </g>
              );
            })}

            {/* Bars and Labels */}
            {timelinePoints.map((p, idx) => {
              const count = timelinePoints.length;
              const slotWidth = (720 / count);
              const barWidth = Math.min(68, slotWidth * 0.55);
              const xCenter = 60 + (idx + 0.5) * slotWidth;
              const barX = xCenter - barWidth / 2;
              const barHeight = maxTimelineRevenue > 0 ? (p.revenue / maxTimelineRevenue) * 150 : 0;
              const barY = 190 - barHeight;

              return (
                <g key={idx}>
                  {/* The Bar */}
                  <rect
                    x={barX}
                    y={barY}
                    width={barWidth}
                    height={Math.max(4, barHeight)}
                    rx="6"
                    ry="6"
                    fill="url(#barGradient)"
                    style={{ transition: 'all 0.3s ease', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                  >
                    <title>{`${p.label}\nDoanh thu: ${money(p.revenue)}\nSố đơn: ${p.orders}`}</title>
                  </rect>

                  {/* Value on top of bar */}
                  {barHeight > 15 && (
                    <text
                      x={xCenter}
                      y={barY - 8}
                      textAnchor="middle"
                      fontSize="11"
                      fill="#047857"
                      fontWeight="700"
                    >
                      {p.revenue >= 1000000 ? `${(p.revenue / 1000000).toFixed(1)} tr` : `${Math.round(p.revenue / 1000)}k`}
                    </text>
                  )}

                  {/* X-Axis Label */}
                  <text
                    x={xCenter}
                    y="212"
                    textAnchor="middle"
                    fontSize="11.5"
                    fill="#475569"
                    fontWeight="600"
                  >
                    {p.label}
                  </text>

                  {/* Order count note */}
                  <text
                    x={xCenter}
                    y="228"
                    textAnchor="middle"
                    fontSize="10"
                    fill="#94a3b8"
                  >
                    {p.orders} đơn
                  </text>
                </g>
              );
            })}
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* BIỂU ĐỒ 2 & 3: DONUT TỶ TRỌNG DOANH THU & BIỂU ĐỒ KHUNG GIỜ CAO ĐIỂM */}
      <div className="split" style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
        {/* DONUT CHART: CƠ CẤU DOANH THU */}
        <Panel title={`Biểu đồ Cơ cấu Doanh thu (${periodLabel})`}>
          <div className="panel-body" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 20 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-around', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 20 }}>
              {/* SVG Donut Circle */}
              <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: 170, height: 170, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center' }}>
                <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" width="170" height="170" style={{ transform: 'rotate(-90deg)' }}>
                  <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="64" fill="transparent" stroke="#f1f5f9" strokeWidth="24" />

                      key={i}

                  <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: '#64748b', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.5, display: 'block' }}>

        <Panel title="Phân bố Khung giờ Cao điểm">

            <div style={{ marginTop: 18, padding: '10px 14px', background: '#fef3c7', borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid #fde68a', fontSize: 12, color: '#92400e', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>

        <div className="panel-body">

                  </div>

            {/* Phân khu V - VIP */}
            <div style={{ background: '#f8fafc', padding: 16, borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid #e2e8f0' }}>

                <strong style={{ fontSize: 13.5, color: '#a16207' }}>Khu V · VIP Clubhouse (2 sân)</strong>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 11.5, color: '#64748b' }}>Lounge thương gia</span>

            <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: '#173c32' }}>Courtly Tennis Club</span>

```jsx
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { UserCheck, CalendarDays, Plus, Search, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Award } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCourtly } from '../context';
import { Title, Panel, Table, Chip, Button, Tabs, Stat } from '../components/UI';
import { money, labels, hourLabel } from '../utils/format';
import { StaffPhoto } from '../components/StaffPhoto';

export default function StaffPage() {
  const { data, show } = useCourtly();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('staff');
  const [staffTypeFilter, setStaffTypeFilter] = useState('ALL');
  const [staffQuery, setStaffQuery] = useState('');

  // Schedules filter & pagination
  const [scheduleStaffFilter, setScheduleStaffFilter] = useState('ALL');
  const [scheduleDateFilter, setScheduleDateFilter] = useState('');
  const [schedulePage, setSchedulePage] = useState(1);
  const schedulePageSize = 15;

  const staffCounts = useMemo(() => {
    const c = { all: data.staff.length, REFEREE: 0, COACH: 0, BALL_BOY: 0 };
    for (const p of data.staff) {
      if (c[p.type] !== undefined) c[p.type]++;
    }
    return c;
  }, [data.staff]);

  const filteredStaff = useMemo(() => {
    return data.staff.filter((p) => {
      if (staffTypeFilter !== 'ALL' && p.type !== staffTypeFilter) return false;
      if (staffQuery.trim()) {
        const q = staffQuery.toLowerCase();
        const match = `${p.name} ${p.phone || ''} ${p.level || ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        if (!match) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [data.staff, staffTypeFilter, staffQuery]);

  // Filtered schedules
  const filteredSchedules = useMemo(() => {
    return data.staffSchedules.filter((s) => {
      if (scheduleStaffFilter !== 'ALL' && s.staff !== scheduleStaffFilter) return false;
      if (scheduleDateFilter && s.date !== scheduleDateFilter) return false;
      return true;
    }).sort((a, b) => (b.date || '').localeCompare(a.date || '') || a.start - b.start);
  }, [data.staffSchedules, scheduleStaffFilter, scheduleDateFilter]);

  // Paginated schedules
  const totalSchedulePages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredSchedules.length / schedulePageSize));
  const currentSchedulePage = Math.min(schedulePage, totalSchedulePages);
  const paginatedSchedules = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentSchedulePage - 1) * schedulePageSize;
    return filteredSchedules.slice(start, start + schedulePageSize);
  }, [filteredSchedules, currentSchedulePage, schedulePageSize]);

  return (
    <>
      <Title
        subtitle="Hồ sơ nhân sự với ảnh mô phỏng trực quan, lịch làm việc và tổng hợp công."
        action={
          <Button className="primary" onClick={() => show({ type: 'entity', collection: 'staff' })}>
            <Plus size={16} style={{ marginRight: 4 }} /> Thêm nhân sự
          </Button>
        }
      >
        Nhân sự & trọng tài
      </Title>

      <Tabs
        options={[
          ['staff', `Đội ngũ nhân sự (${data.staff.length})`],
          ['schedules', `Lịch làm việc (${data.staffSchedules.length})`],
          ['payroll', 'Tổng hợp công'],
        ]}
        value={tab}
        onChange={setTab}
      />

      {tab === 'staff' && (
        <>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 18, flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12 }}>
            <div className="tabs" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
              {[
                ['ALL', `Tất cả (${staffCounts.all})`],
                ['REFEREE', `Trọng tài (${staffCounts.REFEREE})`],
                ['COACH', `HLV (${staffCounts.COACH})`],
                ['BALL_BOY', `Nhặt bóng (${staffCounts.BALL_BOY})`],
              ].map(([t, label]) => (
                <button
                  key={t}
                  className={staffTypeFilter === t ? 'on' : ''}
                  onClick={() => setStaffTypeFilter(t)}
                >
                  {label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <Search size={15} style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 8, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
              <input
                className="search"
                style={{ paddingLeft: 28, width: 220 }}
                placeholder="Tìm tên, chuyên môn..."
                value={staffQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setStaffQuery(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid-cards">
            {filteredStaff.map((p) => (
              <article className="item-card" key={p.id} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
                <div className="card-body">
                  <div className="card-top" style={{ alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                      <StaffPhoto staff={p} size={64} showBadge={true} showCaption={true} />
                      <div>
                        <h2 style={{ fontSize: 17, margin: '0 0 4px 0' }}>{p.name}</h2>
                        <span className={`chip ${p.type === 'REFEREE' ? 'green' : 'blue'}`} style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
                          {labels[p.type] || p.type}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <Chip status={p.status} />
                  </div>

                  {p.level && (
                    <div style={{ margin: '10px 0 6px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: 12, color: '#047857', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                      <Award size={14} /> {p.level}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div className="metric">

              <input
                aria-label="Lọc theo ngày"
                type="date"
                value={scheduleDateFilter}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setScheduleDateFilter(e.target.value);
                  setSchedulePage(1);
                }}
                style={{ width: 140 }}
              />

              {scheduleDateFilter && (
                <Button className="sm" onClick={() => { setScheduleDateFilter(''); setSchedulePage(1); }}>
                  Xem tất cả
                </Button>
              )}

              <Button className="primary sm" onClick={() => show({ type: 'entity', collection: 'staff-schedules' })}>
                <Plus size={14} style={{ marginRight: 2 }} /> Thêm lịch
              </Button>
            </div>
          }
        >
          <Table headings={['Nhân sự', 'Ngày', 'Thời gian', 'Trạng thái', 'Thao tác']} empty={!paginatedSchedules.length}>
            {paginatedSchedules.map((s) => {
              const staffMember = data.staff.find((p) => p.id === s.staff);
              return (
                <tr key={s.id}>
                  <td>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                      <StaffPhoto staff={staffMember} size={30} showBadge={false} />
                      <div>
                        <b>{staffMember?.name}</b>
                        <small style={{ color: '#64748b' }}>{labels[staffMember?.type] || ''}</small>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>{s.date}</td>
                  <td style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{hourLabel(s.start)} – {hourLabel(s.end)}</td>
                  <td><Chip status={s.status} /></td>
                  <td>
                    <Button
                      className="sm"
                      disabled={s.status !== 'AVAILABLE'}
                      onClick={() => show({ type: 'entity', collection: 'staff-schedules', row: s })}
                    >
                      Sửa
                    </Button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </Table>

          {totalSchedulePages > 1 && (
            <div
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                alignItems: 'center',
                padding: '12px 18px',
                borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                background: '#f8fafc',
                fontSize: 13,
                color: '#64748b'
              }}
            >
              <span>
                Hiển thị <b>{(currentSchedulePage - 1) * schedulePageSize + 1}</b> – <b>{Math.min(currentSchedulePage * schedulePageSize, filteredSchedules.length)}</b> trong số <b>{filteredSchedules.length}</b> lịch làm việc
              </span>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                <Button
                  className="sm"
                  disabled={currentSchedulePage <= 1}
                  onClick={() => setSchedulePage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                >
                  <ChevronLeft size={14} style={{ marginRight: 2 }} /> Trước
                </Button>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b', padding: '0 8px' }}>
                  Trang {currentSchedulePage} / {totalSchedulePages}
                </span>
                <Button
                  className="sm"
                  disabled={currentSchedulePage >= totalSchedulePages}
                  onClick={() => setSchedulePage((p) => Math.min(totalSchedulePages, p + 1))}
                >
                  Sau <ChevronRight size={14} style={{ marginLeft: 2 }} />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </Panel>
      )}

      {tab === 'payroll' && (
        <Panel title="Tổng hợp công theo đơn đặt sân hoàn tất">
          <Table headings={['Nhân sự', 'Vị trí', 'Đơn giá / giờ', 'Tổng giờ làm', 'Tổng tiền công']}>
            {data.staff.map((p) => {
              const lines = data.orders.filter((o) => o.status === 'COMPLETED').flatMap((o) => o.staff).filter((s) => s.staffId === p.id);
              const totalHours = lines.reduce((a, s) => a + s.hours, 0);
              const totalPay = lines.reduce((a, s) => a + s.hours * s.rate, 0);
              return (
                <tr key={p.id}>
                  <td>

                  </td>
                  <td><Chip status={p.type} /></td>
                  <td>{money(p.rate)}</td>
                  <td style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{totalHours} giờ</td>
                  <td className="name" style={{ color: '#047857' }}>{money(totalPay)}</td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </Table>
          <div className="panel-body">
            <small style={{ color: '#64748b' }}>
              * Phân công trọng tài cho các trận đấu giải CLB không thu tiền khách theo điều lệ giải. Bảng tổng hợp công này dựa trên các đơn đặt sân đã hoàn tất (COMPLETED).
            </small>
          </div>
        </Panel>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

Hệ thống sẽ tái tạo lại chính xác <b>7 đơn hàng mẫu chuẩn</b>, <b>1 giải đấu 4 đội</b> và <b>1 khách hàng VIP Plus</b> để bảng biểu doanh thu và kịch bản thuyết trình luôn đạt độ hoàn hảo cao nhất.

            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#334155' }}>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 8 }}>Sau khi đặt lại, hệ thống sẽ chứa:</div>
              <ul style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: 20, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>

import React from 'react';

import {useCourtly} from '../context';
import {Title,Chip,Button} from '../components/UI';
import {money,labels} from '../utils/format';
export default function TournamentsPage(){
 const {data,show}=useCourtly();
 return <><Title subtitle="Đăng ký, thu phí, nhánh đấu và lịch thi đấu." action={<Button className="primary" onClick={()=>show({type:'entity',collection:'tournaments'})}>Tạo giải</Button>}>Giải đấu</Title><div className="grid-cards">{data.tournaments.map(t=>{const regs=data.registrations.filter(r=>r.tournamentId===t.id);return <article className="item-card" key={t.id}><div className="card-body"><div className="card-top"><span className="stat-icon"><Trophy size={20}/></span><Chip status={t.status}/></div><h2>{t.name}</h2><p className="subtitle">{labels[t.format]} · {t.location}</p><div className="metric"><span className="muted">Ngày thi đấu</span><span>{t.start}</span></div><div className="metric"><span className="muted">Hạn đăng ký</span><span>{t.deadline}</span></div><div className="metric"><span className="muted">Phí đăng ký</span><b>{money(t.fee)}</b></div><div className="progress"><b style={{width:`${Math.min(100,regs.length/t.max*100)}%`}}/></div><small>{regs.length}/{t.max} đăng ký · {regs.filter(r=>r.status==='CONFIRMED').length} xác nhận</small><div className="card-buttons"><Button className="primary sm" onClick={()=>show({type:'tournament',id:t.id})}>Quản lý giải</Button><Button className="sm" onClick={()=>show({type:'entity',collection:'tournaments',row:t})}>Sửa</Button></div></div></article>;})}</div></>;
}

```java
package com.courtly.config;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

import com.courtly.entity.Account;
import com.courtly.exception.BusinessException;
import com.courtly.repository.*;
import com.courtly.service.SettingsService;
import java.util.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.boot.DefaultApplicationArguments;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.test.util.ReflectionTestUtils;

class DemoDataInitializerTest {
  private CourtRepository courts;
  private AccountRepository accounts;
  private StaffRepository staff;
  private TournamentRepository tournaments;
  private SettingsService settings;
  private PasswordEncoder encoder;
  private org.springframework.core.env.Environment environment;
  private DemoDataInitializer initializer;

  @BeforeEach
  void setUp() {
    courts = mock(CourtRepository.class);
    accounts = mock(AccountRepository.class);
    staff = mock(StaffRepository.class);
    tournaments = mock(TournamentRepository.class);
    settings = mock(SettingsService.class);
    encoder = new BCryptPasswordEncoder();
    environment = mock(org.springframework.core.env.Environment.class);
    when(environment.acceptsProfiles(any(org.springframework.core.env.Profiles.class))).thenReturn(false);

    initializer = new DemoDataInitializer(courts, accounts, staff, tournaments, settings, encoder, environment);
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "adminEmail", "admin@gmail.com");
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "adminPassword", "");
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "enabled", false);
  }

  @Test
  void productionModeDoesNotCreateAdminWithoutPassword() {
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "enabled", false);
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "adminPassword", "");
    when(accounts.findByEmailIgnoreCase("admin@gmail.com")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());
    when(accounts.findAll()).thenReturn(List.of());

    initializer.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments());

    // Never save admin with a guessed password when ADMIN_PASSWORD is blank in production
    verify(accounts, never()).save(argThat(a -> "ADMIN".equals(a.getRole())));
  }

  @Test
  void productionModeDoesNotCreateStaffSampleAccount() {
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "enabled", false);
    when(accounts.findByEmailIgnoreCase("staff@gmail.com")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());
    when(accounts.findAll()).thenReturn(List.of());

    initializer.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments());

    // In production (enabled == false), staff@gmail.com must never be created
    verify(accounts, never()).save(argThat(a -> "staff@gmail.com".equals(a.getEmail())));
  }

  @Test
  void adminPasswordRequiresMinimum10Characters() {
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "adminPassword", "Short1!"); // < 10 chars
    when(accounts.findByEmailIgnoreCase("admin@gmail.com")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

    assertThrows(BusinessException.class, () -> initializer.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments()));
  }

  @Test
  void adminCreatedWithSecurePasswordWhenConfigured() {
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "adminPassword", "SecureClubAdmin2026!");
    when(accounts.findByEmailIgnoreCase("admin@gmail.com")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());
    when(accounts.findAll()).thenReturn(List.of());

    initializer.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments());

    verify(accounts).save(argThat(a ->
        "ADMIN".equals(a.getRole()) && encoder.matches("SecureClubAdmin2026!", a.getPasswordHash())));
  }

  @Test
  void doesNotOverwriteExistingPasswordOnRestart() {
    Account existingAdmin = new Account();
    existingAdmin.setEmail("admin@gmail.com");
    existingAdmin.setRole("ADMIN");
    String changedPasswordHash = encoder.encode("CustomSecretPass2026!");
    existingAdmin.setPasswordHash(changedPasswordHash);

    Account existingStaff = new Account();
    existingStaff.setEmail("staff@gmail.com");
    existingStaff.setRole("STAFF");
    String staffChangedPasswordHash = encoder.encode("StaffChangedPass2026!");
    existingStaff.setPasswordHash(staffChangedPasswordHash);

    when(accounts.findByEmailIgnoreCase("admin@gmail.com")).thenReturn(Optional.of(existingAdmin));
    when(accounts.findByEmailIgnoreCase("staff@gmail.com")).thenReturn(Optional.of(existingStaff));
    when(accounts.findAll()).thenReturn(List.of(existingAdmin, existingStaff));

    initializer.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments());

    // Password hashes must NOT be modified or reset to 12345
    assertEquals(changedPasswordHash, existingAdmin.getPasswordHash());
    assertTrue(encoder.matches("CustomSecretPass2026!", existingAdmin.getPasswordHash()));
    assertFalse(encoder.matches("12345", existingAdmin.getPasswordHash()));

    assertEquals(staffChangedPasswordHash, existingStaff.getPasswordHash());
    assertTrue(encoder.matches("StaffChangedPass2026!", existingStaff.getPasswordHash()));
    assertFalse(encoder.matches("12345", existingStaff.getPasswordHash()));
  }

  @Test
  void devModeInitializesPasswordWhenEnabled() {
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "enabled", true);
    when(accounts.findByEmailIgnoreCase("admin@gmail.com")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());
    when(accounts.findByEmailIgnoreCase("staff@gmail.com")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());
    when(accounts.findAll()).thenReturn(List.of());

    initializer.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments());

    verify(accounts).save(argThat(a ->
        "ADMIN".equals(a.getRole()) && encoder.matches("12345", a.getPasswordHash())));
    verify(accounts).save(argThat(a ->
        "STAFF".equals(a.getRole()) && encoder.matches("12345", a.getPasswordHash())));
  }

  @Test
  void doesNotDemoteExistingAdminIfAdminEmailNotCreated() {
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "enabled", false);
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "adminEmail", "newowner@courtly.vn");
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "adminPassword", ""); // blank, so newowner not created

    Account oldAdmin = new Account();
    oldAdmin.setEmail("oldadmin@courtly.vn");
    oldAdmin.setRole("ADMIN");

    when(accounts.findByEmailIgnoreCase("newowner@courtly.vn")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());
    when(accounts.findAll()).thenReturn(List.of(oldAdmin));

    initializer.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments());

    // oldAdmin must NOT be demoted to STAFF because newowner does not exist
    assertEquals("ADMIN", oldAdmin.getRole());
  }

  @Test
  void doesNotElevateExistingAccountIfAlreadyCustomer() {
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "enabled", true);
    Account customerAccount = new Account();
    customerAccount.setEmail("staff@gmail.com");
    customerAccount.setRole("CUSTOMER");

    when(accounts.findByEmailIgnoreCase("admin@gmail.com")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());
    when(accounts.findByEmailIgnoreCase("staff@gmail.com")).thenReturn(Optional.of(customerAccount));
    when(accounts.findAll()).thenReturn(List.of());

    initializer.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments());

    // Must NOT elevate existing customer to STAFF
    assertEquals("CUSTOMER", customerAccount.getRole());
    verify(accounts, never()).save(customerAccount);
  }

  @Test
  void doesNotElevateExistingCustomerToAdminWhenConfiguringAdminPassword() {
    ReflectionTestUtils.setField(initializer, "adminPassword", "SecureClubAdmin2026!");
    Account customerAccount = new Account();
    customerAccount.setEmail("admin@gmail.com");
    customerAccount.setRole("CUSTOMER");
    customerAccount.setPasswordHash(null);

    when(accounts.findByEmailIgnoreCase("admin@gmail.com")).thenReturn(Optional.of(customerAccount));
    when(accounts.findAll()).thenReturn(List.of(customerAccount));

    initializer.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments());

    // Must NOT elevate existing non-admin account to ADMIN
    assertEquals("CUSTOMER", customerAccount.getRole());
    assertNull(customerAccount.getPasswordHash());
    verify(accounts, never()).save(customerAccount);
  }
}

package com.courtly.config;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.boot.DefaultApplicationArguments;
import org.springframework.core.env.Environment;
import org.springframework.core.env.Profiles;

class ProductionSecurityValidatorTest {
  private Environment environment;
  private ProductionSecurityValidator validator;

  @BeforeEach
  void setUp() {
    environment = mock(Environment.class);
    validator = new ProductionSecurityValidator(environment);
  }

  private void mockSecureDefaults() {
    when(environment.getProperty("spring.datasource.password", "")).thenReturn("SecureProdDbPass123!");
    when(environment.getProperty("server.servlet.session.cookie.secure", "false")).thenReturn("true");
    when(environment.getProperty("courtly.demo-mode", "false")).thenReturn("false");
    when(environment.getProperty("courtly.seed-demo", "false")).thenReturn("false");
    when(environment.getProperty("courtly.security.otp-secret", "")).thenReturn("SuperSecretCryptoRandomKey987654321");
    when(environment.getProperty("courtly.admin-password", "")).thenReturn("AdminStrongPassword2026!");
    when(environment.getProperty("courtly.payment.mode", "")).thenReturn("SEPAY");
    when(environment.getProperty("courtly.payment.webhook-key", "")).thenReturn("LiveSepayWebhookSecret12345");
    when(environment.getProperty("courtly.allowed-origin", "")).thenReturn("https://tennis.courtly.vn");
    when(environment.getProperty("courtly.payment.account-number", "")).thenReturn("987654321098");
    when(environment.getProperty("courtly.mail.host", "")).thenReturn("smtp.gmail.com");
    when(environment.getProperty("courtly.mail.password", "")).thenReturn("test-mail-password");
  }

  @Test
  void nonProdProfileDoesNotEnforceProductionInvariants() {
    when(environment.acceptsProfiles(Profiles.of("prod", "production"))).thenReturn(false);

    // Should not throw even with default/insecure environment values
    assertDoesNotThrow(() -> validator.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments()));
  }

  @Test
  void prodProfileRejectsDefaultDatabasePassword() {
    when(environment.acceptsProfiles(Profiles.of("prod", "production"))).thenReturn(true);
    when(environment.getProperty("spring.datasource.password", "")).thenReturn("courtly_local");

    IllegalStateException ex =
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class, () -> validator.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments()));
    assertTrue(ex.getMessage().contains("Insecure default database password"));
  }

  @Test
  void prodProfileRejectsInsecureCookieSetting() {
    when(environment.acceptsProfiles(Profiles.of("prod", "production"))).thenReturn(true);
    when(environment.getProperty("spring.datasource.password", "")).thenReturn("SecureProdDbPass123!");

    IllegalStateException ex =
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class, () -> validator.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments()));
